title: Casey at the Bat
description: Casey lives with his sister and works in Hicks' general store and post office. The greatest thing in his life is his love for his little niece. To the people of Mudville, Casey is a hero because of his ability to win ball games for their team. Casey is a slugger of worldwide renown, but off the ball field his uncouth ways deprive him of the friendship of any but a half-wit, who follows him around, and the little children to whom he is a hero. Casey develops a love for Angevine, daughter of Judge Blodgett, but she is in love with Bert Collins, who has just returned from college and has been engaged as a pitcher for Frogtown, Mudville's greatest rival for baseball honors. In the meantime Hicks takes to robbing the mails. Casey becomes suspicious of him and about the time he finds evidence of Hicks' guilt, a stranger comes to town. The second game of the big series between Mudville and Frogtown goes to the latter because Casey, who has burned his hands at a country dance where he carried out an oil lamp that exploded, cannot play. But the final game arrives and Casey is ready. Bert is up against it because Angevine's rather has told him he must be able to show $2,000 before he can hope to win his daughter. He gets his mother to mortgage their home and with the money she lends him, he bets with Hicks on the final game. Just before game time, Casey sends word he can't be there because his little niece has fallen from a tree and is dangerously hurt. Hicks is in despair and rushes to Casey's house, only to be kicked out. In the meantime Frogtown forges ahead and the crowd yells for Casey. Casey finally consents to go and leaves the half-wit to watch at the little girl's bedside. He reaches the grounds in the last half of the ninth inning. Mudville is two runs behind; there are two out and two on base. Casey goes to bat. Just at the moment when the pitcher is getting ready to throw the third strike, for Casey always allowed two strikes to be called, the half-wit enters the grounds. Casey sees him, thinks the little girl is dead and strikes out. But the little girl is better; her father, who has been away, returns. Angevine is happy with her lover; the town turns on Casey as a fallen hero and with nothing to hold him, he packs his effects in a little bundle and trudges down the railroad tracks away from the town that has been his home all the years of his life.

title: DARREN at CIANNE
description:
Para sa mga nanay na araw-araw lumalaban nang tapat, kahit walang pahinga at palaging puyat. Sa bawat umaga, ngiti pa rin ang salubong para sa pamilya. Happy Mother's Day, sa mga dakilang ina! Isang early treat para sa mga mommies ang inihanda ng "It's Showtime" family. Ang unang regalo, world-class performance ni "America's Got Talent" Season 20 grand winner Jessica Sanchez sa entablado.

Dahil deserve nila ang korona, mga nanay ang reyna sa "It's Showtime" Laro Laro Pick game arena. Dala nila ang mga kuwentong may kurot sa puso, katulad ng motherhood journey ni Weng, na nagpapatunay sa kasabihang ang pagiging ina ay hindi nasusukat sa dugo.

Maging si Vice Ganda ay naging emosyonal sa kuwento ni Ambeck, na nagpakatotoo sa mga challenging parts ng pagiging ina, katulad ng pagod at minsang 'di pagkakaunawaan nila ng mga anak. Kaya grateful din siya kay mister who doesn't make her feel alone and lonely.

Lahat naman ay napangiti pero si Ryan Bang ay napangiwi sa pinakabagong paandar sa Laro Laro Pick. Sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, sumabak ang "It's Showtime" hosts sa aktingan. Ang sabi, aktingan lang! Pero 'yung sampal ni Jackie Gonzaga kay Ryan, makatotohanan!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa 12 players, bumunot ng host na maglalaro. Pangalan ni Ryan ang na-pick! Araw ni Ryan 'to! Matapang niyang sinugalan ang P350, 000 POT question for his partner player na si nanay Bing.

Pang-MAY-lakasan ang labanan ng mga tubong-Mindanao na sumabak sa Regional Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan. Sina Yeng Constantino, Jed Madela, Jonathan Manalo at special guest hurado Jessica Sanchez, bumilib sa mga pagtatanghal.

Bago sa pandinig ang male version ng "I Am Changing" na ipinamalas ni Aarol Fernandez. Swabe pero mapuso naman ang atake ni Najib Baragona sa pagkanta ng "Paano." At classic hugot ang hatid ni Arafat Usman sa awiting "Mahal Pa Rin Kita."

Entertaining mula simula hanggang dulo ang romantic "I Think They Call This Love" performance ni Arbasa Abdulkarim. Isang OPM harana naman ang piyesa ni Mubarrdh Magabato sa entablado, singing "Bakita Ba Ikaw."

title: Le diable au corps
description: Ce film, qui porte sur la folie et sur la création, vise à démystifier la maladie mentale à travers la présentation d'un groupe d'artistes atteints de troubles psychiques. Parmi la multitude d'êtres humains aux prises avec la maladie mentale - qu'il s'agisse de névrose, de psychose, de schizophrénie, de démence, d'anxiété, de troubles affectifs ou de troubles de la personnalité -, des artistes s'expriment dans des oeuvres empreintes d'une souffrance et d'une émotivité à fleur de peau. Au Centre hospitalier Robert-Giffard, à Québec, ils bénéficient d'un programme d'accompagnement artistique appelé Vincent et moi, qui leur fournit le matériel nécessaire à la pratique de leur art et un lieu d'exposition annuel. C'est une façon de valoriser le malade et de l'inscrire dans la collectivité pour qu'il retrouve l'estime de lui-même et la reconnaissance extérieure. Ce cadre sert de prétexte pour aborder le sujet plus large et plus mystérieux de la maladie mentale, de la folie et de la création. Ces artistes sont authentiques, ils se livrent sans réserve, avec une franchise bouleversante. En point d'orgue, leurs oeuvres, inspirées par ce qu'ils traversent, offrent une version symbolique de la folie, des états intérieurs et de la psychose.

title: Vengeance secrète au casino
description: Il y a six ans, Jiang Sining, la fille bien-aimée de la famille Jiang, a été trahie par sa sœur adoptive, Jiang Sixue. En une nuit, elle a perdu ses parents et s'est retrouvée, sans le savoir, avec un étranger, Qin Shen. title: Ma Montée au Pouvoir Après Son Départ
description: Trahi et ruiné par sa femme Yvonne, Lennox hérite soudain de pouvoirs ancestraux. Lorsqu'Amelia Langford, riche héritière de Grimwood, révèle leurs anciennes fiançailles, il plonge dans un dangereux monde de complots et de cultivation. Des rues de Riverain au sommet de l'élite, il prouvera qu'un homme brisé peut tout conquérir.

title: De la Prison au Palais de Roy
description: Léa Brun a passé trois ans en prison pour un accident causé par son petit-ami, Luc. En échange de sa libération, elle accepte de donner son sang pour sauver Théo Roy, l'héritier d'une puissante famille, alors dans le coma. À sa sortie, Léa découvre que Luc la trompe avec sa patronne. Trahie et sans rien, elle décide de se marier secrètement avec Théo Roy. Mais ce qui ne devait être qu'un accord financier se transforme rapidement en une véritable protection. Ensemble, ils vont s'attaquer à ceux qui ont brisé la vie de Léa.

title: Mon Roi Mafieux au Cœur de Glace
description: Après la mort de son père, Vivian est abandonnée par sa belle-mère Catherine et sa demi-sœur Olivia. Elle est kidnappée et forcée de rejoindre un trafic. Mais son destin bascule le jour où Damien Russo, le redoutable chef de la mafia, la sauve et l’emmène vivre chez lui, sous sa protection. Peu à peu, malgré leur différence d’âge, Vivian développe des sentiments profonds pour Damien, qui, de son côté, lutte pour ne pas céder à la tentation. Lorsque l’existence d’un mariage arrangé entre Olivia et Damien éclate au grand jour, tout s’écroule. Le chaos vient bouleverser leur histoire d’amour naissante, déjà bien compliquée, et met leurs sentiments à rude épreuve.

title: Oliver Stone: The Outsider
description: American film director and screenwriter Oliver Stone is behind films such as Platoon, JFK, Natural Born Killers and Scarface. The Vietnam War and the assassination of Kennedy were decisive events that shaped both Stone and the modern United States. Through unique material from his personal archive and filmography, a close portrait emerges of a controversial filmmaker obsessed with exposing power and national traumas. description: Li Xiaojun, issu d'une famille riche, tombe amoureux de son amie d'enfance Su Xue. Après l'avoir sauvée d'un accident, il reste paralysé. Sa mère engage des médecins pour le soigner et le fait secrètement prétendre être toujours paralysé pour tester l'amour de Su Xue. À la veille de leur mariage, Li Xiaojun prévoit de révéler qu'il est guéri mais découvre la liaison de Su Xue avec son meilleur ami, Zeng Jian. title: Kerstin Ekman - Drottningen av Svartvattnet
description: A documentary journey with author Kerstin Ekman. Following her to the film shoot of her screenplay Varg in Valsjöbyn and Östersund, to a church play based on her novel and research in Lund and to her home in Hallstavik. She is present when her texts meet film, theater, church and readers. The journey continues into her literary world of glass blowing, reindeer herding, cooking, tree logging, church services and human encounters. Focus stays on the trilogy of epic novels Vargskinnet that takes place in Valsjöbyn in north western Sweden where Kerstin Ekman lived for 19 years. In many ways this trilogy captures her authorship; the commitment to society, the love of nature, the complex characters and the sense that people, deeds and time are always endlessly and intrinsically connected.

title: The Peak
description: Fang Hongan (Christopher Ming-Shun Lee) is the chief project superintendent for the construction of drilling platforms. With his assistant, Cai Zhenya (Dawn Yeoh), he goes to Brazil to take part in the assembly of a super-grade drilling platform. An enthusiastic worker, Zhenya tries to accede to all work demands by Hongan, no matter how unattainable. She falls for him over time when she realises his effort to mould her, but Hongan is still pining for his dead fiancée. Tianjun (Yuwu Qi) is also part of a crew for drilling platform construction and has been working in Brazil for two years. While Zhenya dislikes him after a misunderstanding between them, he finds Zhenya rather silly and cute, and eventually falls for her. On the other hand, Xiaoyang (Jeanette Aw) is secretly in love with Tianjun, while Zhihang (Elvin Ng), Zhenya's brother, holds a touch for her since young. See how they overcome the affairs of the heart and work as a team to complete a demanding project to win a distinguished annual safety award. The drama introduces the construction of drilling platforms industry in Singapore and portrays the life experiences of a team of outstanding individuals and how they overcome obstacles and reach the peak of their career, love and friendship.

title: Spice Siblings
description: Laksa stalls abound on the Katong Street lined with famous eateries, and the well-established 'Wen's Laksa' is one of them - Wen He, the eldest son in the Wen family, returns to Singapore after a 13-year stay in Britain, with his daughter in tow. Unbeknown to all, Wen He is counting his days, having contracted bone cancer, and the reason for his return is to have someone take care of his daughter. Things are messy when Wen He first takes over the stall, but he soon gets the hang of the trade with everyone at the coffeeshop helping him, especially Ding Zhenzhu who harbours special feelings for him. Wen He has feelings only for Wen Qing, whom he can only secretly love in his heart. Wen He is actually not Wen Shui's flesh and blood. Wen He's ex-wife returns to Singapore to bring Wen He's daughter back to Britain. But the Wen family will not allow her to take the young child away. She then spills the beans about Wen He's cancer. Not long after, Zhenzhu discovers she is pregnant. How is Wen He going to handle the love triangle ? And will he survive his illness ?

title: Ay Mariposa
description: Ay Mariposa tells a story of three characters in the Lower Rio Grande Valley of Texas whose lives are upended by plans to build a US-Mexico border wall. As the director of the National Butterfly Center, Marianna Trevino Wright has become a leader of wall resistance in the Valley, a position that has resulted in violent threats from pro-wall factions and an emotional odyssey as she tries to navigate the ever-shifting sands of border policy. Zulema Hernandez, a life-long migrant worker, immigrant and great grandmother, has been a dedicated advocate for all migrants, both wild and human-kind. Meanwhile the butterfly, la mariposa, fights its own daily battle for survival in a landscape where more than 95 percent of its habitat is long gone and much of what remains lies directly in the path of the wall. Ay Mariposa documents each characters' fierce commitment to home, justice, wild beauty and the future of the US-Mexico borderlands.

title: Little Vilna: The Last Diary
description: Marta Meszaros, Hungarian filmmaker, returns to her childhood home in Kyrgyzstan. The filmmaker recreates a fiction around the life of her parents in this film entirely devoted to the cult of memory

title: Utolsó vacsora az Arabs Szürkénél
description: Kapa and Pepe come and go in the city: where they drive in an open car on the Danube promenade, where they walk on the concrete vase of the demolished Budapest roundabout in a black balloon reaching the ankle, then boating on the shipyard island, and a large-scale fireworks display begins, Niagara Falls room, and the music is playing unstoppably: Besh O Drom, Sub Bass Monster, Uzgin Üver, Kispál, and the badger - And the Restaurant for the Arabs Gray could be located elsewhere than in the burnt circle.

title: Elöttem az élet
description: The film portrays the everyday lives of disabled children living in the Peto Institute, Budapest.

title: Az utolsó hajnal
description: Lord Harding rescues a suicidal heir and installs him in his household, triggering a dizzying set of circumstances and a startling denouement.

title: Ahol az utak véget érnek
description: Our filming crew followed the folk band from Magyarpalatka on their tour in Hungary to record the great love of the Hungarians for the music from Mezoseg (Transylvania). Alas, on the second day of the shooting which started off in a rather good atmosphere, tragedy struck: the leader of the band, Béla Kodoba, suddenly died of a stroke. Our film followed him to his homeland, the Transylvanian village of Magyarpalatka, where his family, fellow musicians and friends accompanied him on his last journey in deep sadness. At his funeral Gypsy musicians gathered from all parts of the world to bid farewell to the famous violinist with the moving sounds of music. Instead of a road movie, the film "Where the Roads Come to an End" became a film about a final arrival. But it is also a film about a beginning, since it is here where the music of the poor people of Mezoseg gets reborn again and again to go round the world.

title: Az ne zhiveya edin zhivot
description: This is a documentary film-a portrait of the great Bulgarian bass singer Nikolai Giaurov.

title: Baghe Ferdows, Saat 5 Baad Az Zohr
description: When meeting a psychologist reveals a secret life of a girl and her mother.

title: Az utolsó kézirat
description: Friends and family descend upon a dying writer in hopes of getting their hands on his last manuscript.

title: Az én lányom nem olyan
description: Ferenc, a handsome man, is the object of desire of Gitta, both members of a group of middle and upper-middle class youth. Gitta's family, especially her father Peter Hubay are not keen of them being friends because they want Gitta to marry a wealthier man, Sandor. The family is not aware that Gitta and Sandor are already acquainted, as when Gitta's father bans Ferenc from his house, Sandor is the one who passes messages between the lovers. Ferenc becoming more aggressive in his advances towards Gitta but has to realize that she is a morally upright girl. Gitta finds Sandor more and more sympathetic and Ferenc less and less desirable. By the time the Hubay's give a party, Gitta and Sandor have already fallen in love.

title: A skorpió megeszi az ikreket reggelire
description: This is a story of a man who wants to grasp and hold his beloved one by him and a woman who insists on that her love can't be grasped.

title: Az obsitos
description: A young man from a good family named Gyuri falls madly in love with a girl he can't marry. Desperate, and despite the maternal opposition, he enrolls in the army and goes to the front. Some years later, his mother and sister do not know that their long-absent son and brother has been killed in the war. Gyuri's soldier best friend goes to tell them the news, but in the event he can't bring himself to tell them the truth, and introduces himself as Gyuri, whom they haven't seen in many years. But things grow difficult when he finds himself falling in love with his "sister".

title: Lajko - Gypsy in Space
description: In early 1957, the Soviet Union decides to give Hungary the honor of providing the first cosmonaut to orbit in space. The most suitable candidate turns out to be Lajos Serbán, known to all as Lajkó, whose life as a pilot reflects his lifelong attraction to the stars and the outer space.

title: Magyarok az ürben
description: A weekly half-hour sketch comedy show, á la Saturday Night Live.

title: Az poshte panjere
description: Through the Window is a story of a Dalmatian that plays a big role in an Iranian family. He changes the life of the family and the family changes his wild life. Have these changes brought happiness in their lives? What are some of the joys and troubles?

title: Az Rah Reside
description: A young man returns to Iran after a failed marriage experience that he spent in Britain during his studies. Years later, he marries the sister of one of his friends and gets a child. Then a foreign boy comes to Iran and claims that he is his father.

title: Az út
description: The voyage of an old Chinese professor, living in Budapest, to his and present-day China. Can he free himself from his anxieties after years of humiliation? Can one make up for things lost?

title: Az Samime Ghalb
description: Dr. Mehrdad Qaderi marries his favorite daughter Soraya Etemadi and Donya, the neighbor's daughter, who grew up with Mehrdad as a child, attends Mehrdad's wedding with great sorrow. Through the news agency, Soraya is told to go to Bosnia-Herzegovina to cover the news. Soraya goes on this trip despite the opposition of Mehrdad and her mother. But one day the news of Soraya's death reaches Mehrdad and he suffers from mental disorders.

title: Az elíziumi kém
description: Ujszászy has been known as a sly expert, a smooth tactician, a womaniser and the legendary love of the actress Katalin Karády, but he was only interested in the fate of his country. Although, being the leader of the Hungarian Military Intelligence, he regularly informed the Third Empire, Japan and Italy of the military plans of the Allies, but, in order to avoid the ultimate collapse, he became a key figure of the attempt to quit the war, a major negotiator of the Anglo-Americans, who was therefore persecuted by the Nazis. After his prison sentence, the Major General returns to Budapest occupied by the Red Army and is put under house arrest, guarded by the newly established political police. His careerist and unqualified interrogator uses all possible hacks, tips and tricks to acquire the knowledge of the Major General recalling the bygone era of gentlemen but the intrigues of Gábor Péter fail soon. The leader of the State Protection Department has no choice but to make an offer to Ujszászy and an infernal game begins.

title: Az óriás - Magyarok az orenburgi gázvezeték építésen 1975-79
Veri az ördög a feleségét
description: The film condenses the awkwardness of country and functionary existence, consumer thinking based on paternalistic relationships into the sequence of events of 20 August, the feast of the Hungarian new loaf with sentimental irony and documentary credibility. A railwayman's family on the Balaton highlands expects the Budapest relative with his functionary boss and family.

title: Before Sunrise
description: Five friends make a game phoning people and joking on them but one case goes wrong which get them all in trouble.

title: Az elveszett európai
description: This documentary commemorates the life and heroic efforts of Raoul Wallenberg, who rescued thousands of Hungarian jews in 1944.

description: Follows an eccentric police officer and his quirky team whose lives take an unexpected turn after they are assigned a new mission.

title: Good Boy For Stepmom
description: Dad's away until Thursday. His stepmom put him in the room across the hall, shared bathroom, and left her door open on purpose. He says they can't. She says she knows exactly who she is.

title: A Rifle and a Bag
description: Somi and her husband met and fell in love while fighting alongside the Naxalites, a communist guerrilla group that has been fighting since the '60s for the rights of the tribal communities of India. After a decade of armed struggle, the couple deserted the movement and surrendered to the police. Ever since, they have been striving to forge a new identity, educate their two children, and eventually reconcile their violent past with the fervent desire to integrate into the hostile Indian society.

title: A Girl, a Boy, a Penny and a Very, Very, Very Long Road
description: A whimsical road-trip drama about grief, mental health, lost dreams, and the unanswerable question of who we truly are. This heartfelt quirky drama is an indie film that inspires trust, self-love, and bravery.

title: A bankett
description: Right after the Red Army in 1944 was deliberating a little village, Veszto in eastern Hungary, the locals formed their "government", excommunicated the goods remaining in the village and distributed them among the poor. The social experiment only lasted two months, but this episode later became infamous in the communist press of Hungary and was referred to as 'Republic of Veszto'. 35 years later, in 1979, the actors and the witnesses, the representatives of the communist administration back then and the poors of the village get together in a little pub in Veszto and try to resuscitate and evaluate those old days. The memories clash one another.

title: On a Wing and a Prayer
description: On a Wing and a Prayer: An American Muslim Learns to Fly follows Monem Salam as he enrolls in an open-minded flying school, where he soon draws the attention of the FBI, which confirms his family's fears.Monem is a portfolio manager, the son of a Pakistani commercial pilot. His wife Iman's family is Palestinian and although initially dubious about the marriage, now accepts the cultural differences. With three young children, Iman's prankish student days are behind her. She's happy to find time to cultivate her inner domestic diva, wisecracking about her entertaining skills and her husband's flight plans. Monem's "green" decision to commute by scooter only heightens his likability. These modern-day Americans cast off stereotypes and refuse to succumb to victim-hood despite being denied privileges afforded most other Americans. This gently funny film follows Monem as he works towards his goal, engaging his wife, family and community in the process.

title: Heintje: A Heart Goes on a Journey
description: The orphan boy Heintje lives with his aunt, who neglects him badly. He much prefers to be with the racing stable owner Teichmann and his horses. While Teichmann is in Switzerland, Heintje is put in a youth home by his aunt, but manages to escape secretly and makes his way to his fatherly friend. On the journey he melts all adult hearts with his singing, but there is still danger: a gang of smugglers abuses him as an unsuspecting courier, and Hanna, a woman from the youth welfare office, is supposed to ship him back to the home. Luckily, she turns out to be Teichmann's former girlfriend, with whom she promptly gets back together. Together they adopt Heintje.

description: Thirteen-year-old Bo grows up in a protected environment where everything seems possible, but she is frightened by the dark predictions of the future. Together with her friend Luka, she decides to take up the fight against climate change and they join Extinction Rebellion. They occupy factory sites and highways, they are arrested and criticized. But what are politicians doing? Why does all this take so long? As Luka proposes increasingly radical actions, the more thoughtful Bo wants to find her own way. But how can she continue in a world that is eating away at her own future? PLANET B is a coming-of-age story of two youngsters exploring how to grow up in a world destroying itself.

title: Boris I
description: The picture features the life and deeds of Boris I - strong historic personality, which completes his mission to the full and at the end of his life receives holy orders. Prince Boris I is ruling in the late 9th century. In his youth, he, the brilliant statesman and diplomat, is experiencing heavy defeats in the wars he wages against his neighbors. Nonetheless, he manages not to cede any territories to the enemies. Under his rule, Bulgaria breaks with paganism and joins the Christian community, paying an exorbitant price, a heavy death toll, but there is no other way. The adoption of Christianity in 864 was a historical event of great significance. It guaranteed Boris I much need peace with the Eastern Roman Empire and allowed him to merge the numerous tribes inhabiting the country into a unified nationality and later to found a state. Boris I introduced the Slav script, thus turning Bulgaria into the cradle of Slav culture. Stiff resistance, however, met his actions. The former pagan, now Christian king was forced to crush it. Almost half of the then privileged aristocracy - 52 Bulgarian families - were mercilessly killed. Guided solely by his great ambitions Boris blinded and imprisoned his first-born son Vladimir-Rasate who dared against him and instead crowned his youngest son Simeon. It was during his reign that the Golden Age of Bulgarian culture began. This is an epic work dealing with the spiritual ups and downs of a nation and the drama of a great statesman.

title: The Outpost
description: Christopher Clark, an eco-warrior, has established his unique Outpost of Progress in the heart of the Amazon rainforest - a utopian society based on the perfect balance between nature and technology, run and safeguarded by the forest's dwellers. Unfortunately, the situation is getting worse every year, and a new wildfire now threatens to destroy the Outpost. In a daring bid to capture the world's attention about the impending catastrophe and to urge the Brazilian government to create a protective reserve, Chris decides to take a bold gamble: organizing a spectacular Pink Floyd concert amid the verdant inferno. After all, in the mind of a dreamer, the realm of possibilities knows no bounds.

title: L'Atlantide
description: Antinea. the Queen of Atlantis, rules her secret kingdom hidden beneath the Sahara Desert. One day two lost explorers stumble into her kingdom, and soon realize that they haven't really been saved--Antinea has a habit of taking men as lovers, then when she's done with them, she kills them and keeps them mummified.

title: Prisla v noci [Hindi CAM]
description: When a couple of thirty-somethings let the mother of one of them cross the threshold into their home, they have no idea that they have just entered a kind of purgatory. Their peaceful life is slowly transformed into a chaotic wreck. Valerie, a well-groomed woman in her sixties, is an energetic diva who little by little conquers not only the space of the apartment, but also the minds of its occupants. As the creeping home invasion gains force, certainties are undermined and the boundaries of privacy are demolished. Are moms and mothers-in-law always right? Do they have good intentions toward us? And isn't that why they are the scariest monsters of them all?

title: W. What remains of the lie
description: A 50 year-old man -adopted - at the age of five- has no knowledge of his previous history. he thinks that he was born as a Jew in a concentration camp. The people close to Bruno, react with astonishment. In 1998, Bruno meets the Jewish journalist Daniel G, After only 10 minutes, Ganzfried gets that there is something wrong with the story. Today, 17 years after the scandal, Bruno lives a isolated life. The film will nevertheless, or perhaps, describe an aspect of Swiss mentality that refuses to face up to the truth and which suffers under its own insignificance.

title: Luces y sombras
description: A child enters the time of Felipe IV through the picture "Las Meninas" from Velázquez.

title: Hombre y tierra
description: Mauro Bosque was an adventurer, a survivalist, but most of all, he was a dreamer. Mauro spent his days exploring some of the most dangerous places in the world and sharing those adventures on his Internet reality show, HOMBRE Y TIERRA. In January of 2005 he sought out to explore the dense forests of Belize to search for a series of legendary caves which he believes were once home to a clan of historic Mayan warriors. While on that excursion, he was believed to have disappeared without a trace. What happened during that three day hike has remained a mystery until the recent discovery of classified footage stolen from a Belezian government office. This is the story of, THE WOODSMAN.

title: ...sol y lluvia
description: A young Venezuelan woman wants to become Miss Venezuela.

title: Scott y Milá
description: After many years of life and cameras, overcoming a personal blip, Mercedes Milá is reborn on television. As never before, without filters and with laughter, brave and committed. At her side, her faithful and cheerful dog, Scott.

title: Divorciado, Dulce y Dominante
description: La genio Andrea Torres lo sacrifica todo por su esposo, Daniel Rivas, hasta que él la traiciona y humilla con su amante. Destrozada, Andrea se divorcia para vengarse: recupera sus patentes, destruye la empresa de su ex y se casa por sorpresa con su antiguo rival, Maximiliano Ferrer, en un regreso triunfal al mundo de la tecnología.

title: Acapulco, cuerpo y alma
description: A girl trying to find the right man in mexico.

title: Claudia y el deseo
description: A woman falls in love with a man who only wants her as a lover, and in desperation marries another man.

title: The Adventures of Y
description: When the government finds out Big Boss is back in town and stealing garbage cans, they send in the only man right for the job, Y. Which begs the question why him? He's a bumbling middle aged idiot who still lives with his mom; but somehow gets the job done. The Adventures of Y is a silly throw back to the old comedies of yester-year, with a live action cartoon feel.

title: Saber y ganar
description: Quiz show in which the contestants have to answer about general knowledge.

title: El gordo y la flaca
description: Daily celebrity gossip-news show in Spanish.

title: Zoom
description: Former superhero Jack is called back to work to transform an unlikely group of ragtag kids into superheroes at a private academy.

title: Ultraman Z
description: The newest Ultra Hero is Ultraman Zett, the disciple of Ultraman Zero, who is now celebrating his tenth anniversary. An admirer of Zero, Zett worked hard to become a member of the "Inter Galactic Defense Force." With a passion inherited from his teacher Zero, Zett is an Ultraman who always looks forward and forges ahead.

title: Z (Zombie) Reviews
description: John H Shelton takes a look at Zombie films and TV shows featuring the Undead.

description: With the help of the powerful Dragonballs, a team of fighters led by the saiyan warrior Goku defend the planet earth from extraterrestrial enemies.

title: Before and After: Plastic Surgery Clinic
description: What does it take to run a successful plastic surgery clinic? Han Geon Soo (Lee Jin Wook) inherits a plastic surgery clinic after his father's sudden death, only to find that he also inherited the clinic's loan-shark debt. As he struggles to keep the loan sharks at bay, Geon Soo tries to work with the talented plastic surgeon, Hong Ki Nam (So Yi Hyun), nurse Choi Yong Woo (Kim Sung Min) and the office manager, Yoon Seo Jin (Jung Ae Yun).

title: Bulgeun bikini
description: A young couple and their male friend's trip to Pattaya, Thailand turns to hell when their secrets become open with the help of a sexy girl in red bikini.

title: Green Days [English]
description: Not wanting to lose, Yi-rang orchestrates a collapse in the middle of a relay race even though she's on the verge of giving up her dream of becoming an athlete. At the same time, Soo-min transfers in from Seoul and Cheol-soo, who dreams of becoming a scientist, come into her life. They are all immature but they are in the midst of youthful aspiration. With this warm-hearted animation, HAN Hye-jin and AN Jae-hoon encourage Yi-rang's dreams and portray the fantasy and flutter of adolescence through encounters with good people. Set in the '80s and '90s, an old umbrella and a railroad crossing the downtown in the film is the stuff that reminds us of our lost past, evoking a reminiscence in the audience of that which is vanished. It is a way of evoking the real "dreams" that we have lost in this modern society where a rapid capitalization is progressing.

title: af-adom
description: During 2008, under the barrage of Kassam rockets, a clown was wandering around the streets of the city of Shderot. The clown nurtured special relationships with an Ethiopian kid named Yaa'kov, who dreamed to study the clown's art, hoping it would help him to leave the city. The movie follows the clowns' attempts to teach Yaa'kov to become a street theater artist, in spite of the antagonism Yaa'kovs' friends developed towards him because of his new hobby, until the street theater show they created together. The movie deals with the friendship between a kid with a dream and a street theater artist who hangs onto hope, and with a man who did not remove his makeup and remained the last one to smile.

title: Mackan
description: Mackan's real name is Margaret. She is 14 and move a lot because her father is employed at the Railroad Company. In a small town she meets Kenneth.He is 18 and the coolest guy in town. Their relationship is a major triumph for Mackan.

title: Vägen ut med Lars Lerin
description: The artist Lars Lerin takes with her husband Junior and eight friends he got to know on the way out of his addiction on a trip through Sweden, from the High Coast,

title: Läpi usvan
description: Pertti works as a telegraph operator on a ship. When it arrives in Helsinki, Pertti looks forward to seeing his mother again, and also the neighbor girl, with whom he is in love. But his plans change when he steps into a restaurant with the first officer of the ship when they go ashore.

title: One Hundred Steps
description: "I cento passi" (one hundred steps) was the distance between the Impastatos' house and the house of Tano Badalamenti, an important Mafia boss, in the small Sicilian town of Cinisi. The movie is the story of Peppino Impastato, a young left-wing activist who in the late seventies (when almost nobody dared to speak about the Mafia, and several politicians maintained that the Mafia did not even exist) repeatedly denounced Badalamenti's criminal activities and the whole Mafia system, by using a small local radio station to broadcast his political pronouncements in the form of ironic humour. In 1978 Peppino (30 years old) was killed by an explosion. The police archived the case as an accident or a suicide, but his friends never accepted this conclusion. Note: This is a true story. More than twenty years after Peppino's death, the case has been re-opened. Tano Badalamenti, meanwhile, has been convicted in the USA for drug trafficking.

title: Ah Wa Ah Mn Sharbat
description: Noha finds herself charged in a murder case. Her father,the former police officer, discovers that the one behind the crime is her twin sister who he thought died while she's living with a gang. Her father tries to bring her back home.

title: [Doblado]Ahora lo Recuperará Todo
description: Carmen, heredera de la mafia, regresa a Madrid y descubre que su hija Aurora ha sufrido abusos atroces a manos de su propia familia. Desafiando las órdenes del sindicato, desata una sangrienta venganza para salvar a su hija y enfrenta a su traicionero esposo. Pero cuando todo termina, ¿quedará algo de la mujer que fue?

title: Ai-Chan's Secret
description: An athletic tomboy, Aiko "Ai" Kasumi (Yuna Taira) absolutely loves basketball. A member of her school's basketball club, Ai can easily outplay everyone at school, including every member of the boys' basketball team, with the exception of one. A star both on the court and off, Reo Amano (Kanta Sato) can not only out-play Ai on the court but has just as many adoring fans in school, making him the proverbial thorn in Ai's side. Envious of Reo's skill and popularity, Ai declares him her rival and is determined to outdo him, every chance she gets. But out-performing the best isn't easy, even with skills as amazing as Ai's. Always feeling like she's one step behind Reo, Ai struggles to find a way to take down her greatest rival. Lucky for her, fortune decides to smile upon her in the most unexpected way. With her brother's maid cafe in desperate need of help, Ai agrees to start working part-time. But her brother won't give her the job unless she's willing to take on a more girly look. With a wig and some makeup, Ai trades her usual tomboy look for one more suited to the role of maid cafe waitress. Sporting her new look, Ai inadvertently catches the eye of Reo, who wastes no time in asking her out. With plans to make Reo fall madly in love with her so that she can then dump him and leave him heartbroken, Ai sees dating Reo as the perfect way to take down her greatest rival. But could the time they spend together cause her to have a change of heart?

title: Pizi yu dao ai
description: Wang Rui is an unrealistic do-nothing guy who lives in Beijing. One day, his grandfather tells him that he owns a piece of land in Kenting, Taiwan. Wang, who has never been to Taiwan, travels to Kenting with his good friend Tien-Tsai. The two assume that selling the land should be fairly easy, but what they do not expect is that they need to collect 128 co-owneres' signatures for their agreements. Wang Rui and Tien-Tsai decide to divide and conquer. Will they get the agreements successfully? Or will they change their minds after spending time with the hospitable people in the beautiful south of Taiwan?

title: Al Waad
description: Al Waad

title: Al-Shahid Al-Wahid
description: Sarah is a famous fashionista. One of her admirers appears, and during their first meeting, Sarah runs over a passerby. However, the fan covers up the incident and starts to blackmail her to interfere in her life.

title: Mamno Al Eqterab Aw Al Tasweer
Al Wohosh Al Sagheera
description: Ahmed drops out of Faculty of Engineering due to financial difficulties and works in the workshop that his father left him. Although he loves Tahyia the poor nurse, she marries a rich Arab man who dies and she inherits him.

title: Al Arafa
description: A series of enigmatic prophecies sets in motion a whirlwind of events in the lives of Dr. Ibrahim and lawyer Hazem. Through their journey, we delve into their struggles, caught in a limbo of time, in a tale brimming with suspense.

title: Al jaguar al saouda
description: A blind girl falls in love with a young man, unaware that he is a drug smuggler. As he gets a large shipment of drugs, he tries to hide them in the blind girl's house without her knowledge, only to be shocked when he discovers that she can see.

title: Al-Waratha
description: Two brothers, one a successful engineer, the other is a reckless who failed in his studies.  The father leaves all his wealth to the engineer for fear of loss at the hands of his second son, which creates hatred with the son and he tries to get rid of his brother.

title: Fahad Al Askkar Al Rehla Wa Al Raheel
description: Fahad Al Askkar Al Rehla Wa Al Raheel

title: Al Rajul Al Raabie
description: A satire look at the current state of cinema, when an outside producer decides to make a B-grade movie in a short period.

title: Al Asli
description: Fatima Al Asli seeks to protect her father's legacy from being lost. She believes that she is entitled to it and refuses to divide it among her brothers. She tries to control everything by plotting against them, so the bond of brotherhood turns into chains of fire that burn everyone.

title: Al Hafla
description: A young man searching for his wife who disappeared mysteriously, and a detective who is trying to unravel the mystery surrounding this suburban neighbourhood...

title: Al-aragoz
description: A father keeps his principles in rural Egypt while power seduces his son in Cairo. Mohamed is a puppeteer, a buffoon whose shows dramatize the promise of Nasser's socialist revolution. He's a widower with one son, Bahlool, whom he sends to university at great financial and emotional sacrifice. In Cairo, Bahlool becomes the protege of a corrupt pasha, marries the pasha's daughter, and sets his sights on Parliament. Meanwhile, his father falls in love with Enaam, a spirited carnival worker. He continues to pray for Bahlool, hoping to rekindle ethics and revolutionary ideals in the young man, until his son's ambitions put Enaam at risk.

title: Inuuvunga: I Am Inuk, I Am Alive
description: Eight Inuit teens offer a vibrant view of life in Canada's North.

title: I Am Fear
description: Held captive by terrorists, celebrity reporter, Sara Brown, sits in a cell awaiting her filmed beheading. Sara's captors wish to show the world the true face of terror but how can they, when even they have not seen it yet?

description: Tony Malatini, a puppeteer, at Paris' Theatre des Marionettes notices that his audience consists of only 7 people. He goes backstage to see her and asks her if he can make a puppet of her to use in his show. Over-hearing this, the Baron, Suzanne's controlling manager, castigates Suzanne threatening to set her free. Suzanne terrified of being on her own, begs the Baron to marry her and not to leave her. Tony comes during one of Suzanne's performances and begs her not to marry the Baron. Upset, Suzanne falls into the orchestra pit and injures herself to the extent that she won't dance again. Baron leaves Suzanne, but Tony with a doctor's help puts her through a vigorous exercise program. Tony also shows her how to be a puppeteer. Tony confesses to Suzanne that his true friends are his puppets. He picks up the puppet of Suzanne and tells her that he is in love with this puppet. Suzanne not realizing that he means her becomes confused. Together they put on a successful celebrity puppet show. During a celebration party, Tony decides he will propose marriage to her uniquely. He picks up the puppet of her and asks it to marry him. Suzanne becomes jealous and confused...

title: I Am Sam Kinison
description: I Am Sam Kinison is a feature-length documentary film exploring the life and legacy of shock comic Sam Kinison, a former Pentecostal preacher turned stand-up comic who repurposed his pulpit-honed chops to the brazen rock 'n roll world of MTV-era comedy. Following a steep trajectory to fame, excess, despair and near-redemption, Sam meets a sudden and early death when struck by a drunk driver in 1992. Using extensive clips from his comedy specials that cover some of his favorite topics including marriage, women, homosexuality, God, religion and world hunger Sam tells much of his story himself in a barrage of comedic feints and blows, shrieking and misanthropic riffing. Added perspective is provided by a dynamic cast of friends, family, fellow comics and celebrity party-mates, augmented by animated sequences that illustrate and add color to energetic and often hilarious interviews. Key interviews include the inspired storytelling of Jay Leno, Bill Burr, Ted Nugent, Charlie Sheen, Joe Rogan, Corey Feldman, Bob Saget, Tommy Chong, Ron Jeremy, and others. Starting with a childhood head injury, Sam's story plots a course of failure, from his time as a Pentecostal preacher, culminating in a humiliating marriage. Finally stepping onto a comedy club stage in Houston, he finds his voice and true calling but it takes years of struggle before mainstream audiences are ready to hear his message. Yet with all the unbridled profligacy of his eventual fame and fortune, Sam never loses his faith in God and his raucous story is replete with biblical themes fueled by sex, drugs and rock 'n' roll. I Am Sam Kinison shocks, shticks and screams its way through a life and a wild career that shattered the status quo and changed comedy forever.

description: Une brillante générale est promue à un haut rang. Dix ans après, alors qu'un mariage arrangé se prépare, la révélation de son identité féminine déclenche un scandale à la cour. Contrainte à la démission, elle regagne sa ville natale, pendant que son fiancé se voit gratifié d'un titre noble. Aveuglé par l'ambition, ce dernier délaisse les siens pour épouser une impostrice et maltraite sa fiancée. Elle y forme une alliance avec le premier ministre pour démasquer les corruptions qui menacent l'empire. Finalement, leur collaboration les mène à la victoire.

title: Let It Go
description: Yan Neo (Jeanette Aw) is a well-known blogger who writes about her past relationships.Not only does she detail her failed relationships, she does not mind publicly shaming her exes. She lives with her roommate, Man (Cavin Soh), who is a Make-Up artist, and her best friend, Du Jia Yi (Mindee Ong). Jia Yi breaks up with her boyfriend after finding out he is cheating on her. However Jia Yi still harbors hope, so Ah Man recommends Mark Chow (Elvin Ng), a freelance photographer to Yan for help in gathering evidences.Mark misunderstands Yan's well intentions for Jia Yi. Both of them have conflicting views over how one should move on happily. As time goes by, Mark sees the good in Yan and understands Yan's beliefs. Over time, the two of them develop feelings for each other. Yan does not believe in true love and will never whole-heartedly commit herself in a relationship. In all her relationships, Yan is always the one who initiates break-ups. However, Yan has fallen in love with Mark and wants to break free from him. Can Yan finally let go of her skepticisms and embrace a happier self?

title: Istanbul Beneath My Wings
description: The story takes us back to the 17th century Istanbul, and the powerful times of the Ottoman Empire under the rule of Sultan Murad IV. Hezarfen Ahmet Celebi, Logari Celebi, Bekri Mustafa and Evliya Celebi are four good friends who do research to enable human beings to fly.

title: Kapag Ako Ay Nagmahal
description:
Gumawa ng kasaysayan ang mga Pilipinong mang-aawit na nagsalpukan sa isang matinding Huling Tapatan ng 'TNT Duest 2.’ Umupo bilang mga hurado sina Ogie Alcasid, Bituin Escalante, Kyla, Erik Santos, Nyoy Volante, Darren Espanto, JM Yosures, Jonathan Manalo, at si Maestro Louie Ocampo ang nagsilbing Punong Hurado.

Mula sa weeklong Grand Finals, anim na pares ang umabante sa Huling Tapatan. Unang sumalang ang 'IN-2-U' Isay Olarte at Nowi Alpuerto na binigyan ng fierce and playful energy ang OPM hit na "Awitin Mo at Isasayaw Ko." Makatunaw-puso naman ang pinagsamang tinig nina Christian Tibayan at Arvery Lagoring a.k.a. 'OST Dreamers' na inawit ang "Sa Ngalan Ng Pag-Ibig."

Breaking stereotypes, intense vocal talent at showmanship ang ibinuhos ng 'Dugong Bughaw' Miah Tiangco at Eunice Encarnada sa kanilang "Banal Na Aso, Santong Kabayo" performance. Sumabog ang kilig sa studio nang kantahin nina Thor Valiente at Pia Carandang a.k.a. 'TNT Bestmates' ang "Can You Read My Mind."

Mga puso’t tinig na palaban, pinag-isa ng 'Jezzian' sa tanghalan. Hinaplos nina Jezza Quiogue at Ian Manibale ang emosyon ng mga hurado sa pag-awit ng "Bawat Daan." Napaiyak rin ang iba sa pagtatanghal ng 'Pangmala-COUSINS' JR Oclarit at Mark Justo na binigyan ng bagong buhay ang "Kung Maibabalik Ko Lang."

Itinanghal na TOP 3 ang Pangmala-COUSINS, Jezzian at OST Dreamers, na naghatid ng exciting three-way battle sa final round kung saan muli silang umawit ng panibagong mga piyesa.

Sa final round, swabe pero mapuso ang atake ng Pangmala-COUSINS, singing "All My Life" by K-Ci and JoJo. 'All the feels' naman ang hatid ng "You'll Be Safe Here" ng Jezzian. At nakatanggap agad ng standing ovation mula sa mga hurado ang OST Dreamers bago pa man matapos ang kanilang "Kapag Ako Ay Nagmahal" performance.

Sa dulo, nasungkit ng Pangmala-COUSINS ang huling puwesto sa score na 95.4%, at pumangalawa ang Jezzian na may gradong 95.6%. Kuminang nang todo ang pinagsamang husay nina Christian at Arvery (OST Dreamers) na 'almost perfect' ang nakuhang marka, 99.6%.

Samantala, hindi pa rin nawala an kulitan ng ‘Showtime’ family! Si Kim Chiu, ‘bunot’ ni Vice Ganda dahil tila emosyonal daw ito sa mga performances. Nag-react din si Meme tungkol sa isa na namang ‘viral’ video niya. At sina Ian at Jezza, hindi nakatakas sa

asaran. Bakit gano’n? Ang usapan, kantahan, pero para bang na-transport daw ang Madlang People sa kasalan ng Jezzian?!

title: Pockam, az zabijes
description: The Second World War. Dogs are being trained for guard duty in the Nordfelsen training center. Concentration camp prisoners are used as targets for attack, and are forced to provoke the dogs and get them to feel hatred for the striped prison uniform. One of the prisoners is Mares, a former member of the International Brigade in the Spanish Civil War. He has been allocated the Alsatian bitch Rita, and is secretly training her in a different way. He just pretends to beat her and at night, he goes and feeds her leftover scraps of food. Mares is planning an escape with his fellow prisoner Benda.

title: Az Tehran ta Ghahere
description: Footage from the Iranian revolution and the years of exile is played for the first time for Queen Farah Pahlavi, and she responds with her recollection of each event. yet deeply personal account of the journey of Iran's Royal Family.

title: Az ember néha téved
description: Anna Tokes consents to a loveless marriage to Gyula Csortos to save her father (Gyula Gozon) from being jailed by his creditors. Her engagement broach is stolen, and through a series of plausible Hungarian happenings it turns up in the apartment of bachelor Antal Pagel. Eventually, it gets back to Csortos, who isn't buying her explanation. But, having met Pagel, the end of a loveless romance is just the beginning of a real one, and Anna hasn't had to make any sacrifices to save her father.

title: Az grafinyata
description: A Bulgarian "Drugstore Cowboy." A teenage girl's rebellion through drugs becomes a metaphor for the struggle between individuality and totalitarianism. Amidst the political upheaval of 1968, Sybilla (the "Countess") is sent to a girls' re-education camp when she is caught using drugs. After a failed affair and an abortion, Sybilla's drug use lands her in a mental clinic where she resists efforts to remold her personality. Based on a true story.

title: Az utolsó nyáron
description: Imre Horváth and his friends gather to celebrate his wife's birthday. They are confused because of the changes in the country's politics and want Horváth to be much more active politically, but he is more concerned about his affair with his best friend's daughter.

title: Mardi az Esfahan
description: A young worker who works in a company in Isfahan wants to sue his boss. He comes to Tehran for the house of his Boss. But there the daughter of his boss who has problems with her fiance sees him. This put him to take many adventures.

title: I Know How Many Runs You Scored Last Summer
description: A cricket team are dismissed by a moustachioed serial killer with a razor sharp cricket glove and an arsenal of sharpened stumps. One by one the killer exacts revenge for the torment he endured 20 years earlier.

title: Narinig mo na ba ang l8est?
description: Popoy (Aga Mulach) is a handsome, eligible bachelor, but instead of the usual macho activities a guy of this day and age would indulge in, Popoy is more interested in culinary pursuits and better-living breakthroughs. He dresses himself neatly, he sweats perfume, he respects the female species in a way that he refuses to see them as sex objects, and he lives with his grandmother. People around him label him gay. Gina (Joyce Jimenez), on the other hand, looks like the typical bimbo, whose appeal lies mainly on the bulk between her shoulders and waist. Her reputation among men precedes anything she might need to prove about herself. Both know that the other exists--each has unfavorable first impressions of the other; a relationship is hardly worth pursuing amid piles of work. But in pursuit of a 400million account, no personal difference matters: Popoy and Gina must team up to help their agency create a winning pitch. In no time, they discover and fall for the real person behind the cloud of labels affixed on the other. But before they can realize and express how they truly feel, peer pressure causes Popoy to betray Gina. He has been eyed for a promotion but is hindered by rumors about his sexual orientation. His friends press-ganged on him to validate his manhood by saying that he has slept with Gina. Gina doubts their friendship and Popoy's sincerity--he might have been like any other guy after all. Learning that the one true thing in this cynical world might turn out to be a sham breaks Gina's heart. Popoy, in all his guilt, decides to give up that world in which he thrived and survived. Gina finds out Popoy's sacrifice and runs back into his arms. They both realize that happiness lies on the love they have for each and not on the luster of the image they chose to project, or on their professional achievement.

title: Francesca Next Door
description: Woo-ju, a model student and class president who has devoted everything to getting into medical school, finds his life turned upside down when Pi Na-young, a vampire transfer student from Romania, arrives at his school. After accidentally becoming the keeper of her secret, Woo-ju finds himself looking after both her studies and school life. As the two constantly bicker and clash, unfamiliar feelings begin to blossom between them, leaving Na-young increasingly confused as she struggles to tell whether her racing heart for Woo-ju is the feeling of falling in love or simply her vampire instincts.

title: Programming in Python
description:
In this course, you will be introduced to foundational programming skills with basic Python Syntax. You’ll learn how to use code to solve problems. You’ll dive deep into the Python ecosystem and learn popular modules, libraries and tools for Python. 
You’ll also get hands-on with objects, classes and methods in Python, and utilize variables, data types, control flow and loops, functions and data structures. You’ll learn how to recognize and handle errors and you’ll write unit tests for your Python code and practice test-driven development.
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
•	Prepare your computer system for Python programming
•	Show understanding of Python syntax and how to control the flow of code
•	Demonstrate knowledge of how to handle errors and exceptions
•	Explain object-oriented programming and the major concepts associated with it
•	Explain the importance of testing in Python, and when to apply particular methods
This is a beginner course for learners who would like to prepare themselves for a career in back-end development or database engineering. To succeed in this course, you do not need prior web development experience, only basic internet navigation skills and an eagerness to get started with coding.

title: Spartacus: House of Ashur - Soundtrack | Ashur Ascends | John Hannah & Lucy Lawless | Starz 9p
description:
Step into the blood-stained sands of Capua with Ashur Ascends, an original track inspired by the upcoming Spartacus: House of Ashur. This atmospheric piece blends ancient percussion, war-drums, and haunting Eastern melodies to capture the ruthless rise of Ashur — the most cunning schemer in the gladiator world.

Before Spartacus ever set foot in the arena, Ashur was already weaving lies, alliances, and betrayals inside the House of Batiatus. This track is crafted to reflect his transformation from a struggling gladiator to a master manipulator navigating Roman politics, violence, and survival.

Spartacus: House of Ashur is expected to release in late 2025 / early 2026 and will stream exclusively on Starz.
If you're a fan of the original Spartacus series, gladiator lore, intense character arcs, and cinematic soundscapes, this one’s for you.

Welcome to Popcorn & Tracks — where stories meet sound.

#Spartacus #HouseOfAshur #AshurAscends #PopcornAndTracks #SpartacusSeries #StarzOriginal #

description: Woo-ju, a model student and class president who has devoted everything to getting into medical school, finds his life turned upside down when Pi Na-young, a vampire transfer student from Romania, arrives at his school. After accidentally becoming the keeper of her secret, Woo-ju finds himself looking after both her studies and school life. As the two constantly bicker and clash, unfamiliar feelings begin to blossom between them, leaving Na-young increasingly confused as she struggles to tell whether her racing heart for Woo-ju is the feeling of falling in love or simply her vampire instincts.

title: Reunited Worlds [Hindi]
description: Sung Hae Sung (Yeo Jin Goo, Circle: Two Worlds Connected) is a cheery high school student. Being the eldest sibling, he wants to provide for his family instead of going to college. On the day of his 19th birthday, he gets into a car accident and passes out. He wakes up on the top of his school building. He thinks he survived and everything is normal. Except everyone thinks he died 12 years ago, and he hasn't aged at all. Jung Jung Won (Lee Yeon Hee, The Package) is Hae Sung's best friend. She was the one who took him to the place where he had his accident. Distraught, she has been unable to move on from the incident since. Having failed to pursue her dreams under the stress, she works as a kitchen assistant at a nice restaurant. Cha Min Joon (Ahn Jae Hyun, Cinderella and Four Knights) is the owner of the restaurant where Jung Won works. He has feelings for her. However, she has never shown any interest in him. In her mind, she can't be with anyone while carrying Hae Sung in her memories. One night, Jung Won finds a young man passed out in front of her house. He is Hae Sung, her first love. She is now 31; he is 19. Can they pick up their love where they left off, or will their reunited worlds always stay separate? Also known as "Into the World Again" and "Into the New World," Reunited Worlds is directed by Baek Soo Chan and written by Lee Hee Myung, the creative team behind Beautiful Gong Shim and Sensory Couple.

title: King in Disguise
description: After a decade of risking his life to save others, billionaire heir Ved returns home only to be mistaken for a beggar. Humiliated, beaten, and forced to kneel by a greedy influencer and her ruthless brother—who are plotting to seize his family's empire—Ved silently endures everything to protect his sister. But when his true identity is revealed, their world is about to collapse.

title: Final Breakup
description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

title: Payback for Parivaar
description: The story revolves around Hardik, a man wrongfully accused of a crime against his own family. After spending years in jail, he returns with only one goal - to prove his innocence and expose the real culprit hiding within his family. Supported by Radhika, he begins a powerful journey of revenge, truth, and redemption. Watch now!

title: Adha Pyar
description: Chandni enters Somesh’s life pretending love but secretly plots with Rajiv to seize his empire. Through manipulation, murder, and betrayal, she destroys his family and leaves him broken. Surviving against all odds, Somesh uncovers their crimes, outsmarts them, and turns the game around. As greed and deceit consume Chandni and Rajiv, Somesh rises from “andha pyaar” to calculated revenge, ultimately reclaiming justice, family, and love.

title: Delivery King
description: A humble delivery man is mocked by everyone, but behind his ordinary appearance lies a business genius with unimaginable wealth and influence. As he repeatedly saves a powerful CEO from financial ruin, shocking secrets about his true identity leave his enemies stunned and his allies questioning everything.

title: Ikka Number Paanch
description: Young guy, who is a master of card games, reunites with his family who had discarded him years ago - and goes on to save them and their casino. There are multiple games involving card tricks, gambling themes where stakes are the highest - and our hero overcomes obstacles and wins them one by one.

title: Khamosh Dil
description: A passionate journalist, Akshat, loses his voice in an accident caused by his ambitious wife Twinkle, who soon begins to resent and humiliate him. As their marriage crumbles, Akshat rebuilds himself with the help of his childhood friend Reena, creating a revolutionary voice device. Rising from silence to success, he exposes betrayal, reclaims dignity, and finds his true voice.

title: He comes from the mountains  [Hindi]
description: .He comes from the mountains

title: Million Dollar Mother [Hindi]
description: The Mother Crown is a powerful family drama about love, sacrifice, and betrayal. Sangeeta, who raised three sons into a world-renowned doctor, businessman, and writer, finds her motherhood questioned when strangers claim she kidnapped them 25 years ago. As her sons turn against her, shocking truths and hidden powers surface—revealing that their entire success may not be their own, but the result of a mother’s secret crown.

title: Raja Sahab Returns
description: Surya, a former jailer and the secret kingpin of the coal mining empire, hides his true identity to give his son Adarsh a normal life. But when Adarsh is brutally humiliated, tortured, & kidnapped by the arrogant son of Surya’s own former ally, Surya is forced to step back into the world he left behind. As enemies try to destroy him and take over his empire, Surya returns as Raja Sahab,  not just to reclaim his throne, but to protect his son, destroy his enemies, & clean his empire from within.

title: Unworthy Love
description: Separated from his wealthy family after a childhood accident and raised in poverty, Navneet lives as a humble junk dealer while secretly rising to become a mysterious billionaire CEO. While hiding his elite identity to test the character of those around him, he must protect his long-lost mother and daughter from the greed and humiliation of arrogant socialites.

title: Autowala Billionaire
description: A billionaire couple goes undercover as poor to test their son’s character, only to watch him lose his values, fall for a toxic heiress, betray them — and eventually face a shocking truth that shatters every relationship. Watch now.

title: Jamai on EMI [Hindi]
description: Betrayed on her engagement day, Maira Ramani impulsively fakes a relationship with Naksh, the charming hotel owner with secrets of his own. What begins as a deal to save face and secure family inheritances soon spirals into a complicated web of emotions, lies, and unexpected love. Will their fake marriage turn into something real?

title: Bulletproof Ishq
description:
A feared builder RD's life is saved by an innocent girl, Heer sparking a bond that turns dangerously intimate.
 As she uncovers his son’s betrayal, she becomes the target of brutal humiliation and cruelty. When she hits rock bottom, the man she saved rises as her protector, exposing a truth that shatters his own family.  In the end, love survives but only after betrayal, blood, and a legacy destroyed from within.

title: Bade Miyaan Deewane
description: In a famine-stricken kingdom of Bhopal, on the brink of war in 1981, a starving old man Bundu Khan discovers a mysterious spirit that grants his deepest wishes. To escape being sent to die in battle, he impulsively marries three cousin sisters and promises them safety. But as Bundu grows younger and stronger with every act of love and compassion, enemies, betrayal, and war close in—testing whether this unlikely family can survive together. Watch Now!

title: Arranged to Love
description: A billionaire businessman, Vikram Singhania, has to enter into an arranged marriage with Dr. Bhoomi Arora because of family pressure. What starts as a cold, forced marriage slowly transforms into an unexpected journey of trust, passion, and love. Arranged to Love is a romantic drama where duty collides with desire, and two strangers must decide if their hearts can truly meet.

title: Lady Boss Returns
description:
My Boss Lady is a modern romantic drama set against the glittering world of luxury hotels, real estate empires, and high-stakes corporate alliances.
 It explores love, betrayal, and revenge through the journey of Kiara Bhansali, a self-made billionaire who hides her identity to test loyalty and integrity — and ends up meeting Tej Jaisingh, an ambitious CEO caught between love and legacy.
Their accidental meeting spirals into a whirlwind of mistaken identities, class clashes, fake marriages, and boardroom battles — until Kiara’s true power as the “Sky Queen” turns the game upside down.
 The series balances romantic comedy, emotional redemption, and corporate intrigue, delivering a story about a woman reclaiming love and respect on her own terms.

title: Pyar Dhoka or Promotion
description:
In the glamorous yet cutthroat world of corporate power, secrets are the ultimate currency. Simran and Purab, two high-profile executives, are bound by a marriage they keep hidden from the very empire they run thanks to strict company policies. But behind closed doors, their relationship is on the verge of collapse.

Enter Veer and Tanya, ambitious new interns who quickly realize that charm can be just as powerful as talent.

title: We, the Emperor
description: Watch "We, the Emperor" Only On KUKKU TV!

title: God Of Cricket
description: A Janitor is a hidden fireball bowler who saves a cricket team from losing the Delhi premiere league.

title: The Undercover Lady CEO
description: When TerraGem’s young VP Alisha Talwar goes undercover as an intern to expose a massive money-fraud, a ruthless social climber, Reva, steals her identity as “Mrs. Talwar” and turns the office into a bullying circus. To save her marriage, her company—and her own name—Alisha must outplay the impostor and catch the laundering ring before it destroys her.

title: Ready Daddy Go!
description: One night, a strict corporate father and his rebellious teenage son mysteriously swap souls — forcing the dad to survive high school drama and the son to run a high-pressure office — only to discover that walking in each other’s shoes might be the only way to fix their broken bond.

title: Ek Anjana Rishta
description: Seven years after Diwali destroyed his life, billionaire Samrat Singh lives in guilt, believing his wife Shreya and their unborn child died in a tragic accident caused by his powerful father’s cruelty. Unknown to him, Shreya survived—left paralysed, traumatised, and living on the streets with her young daughter Jiya, who grows up scavenging bottles to keep her mother alive. Fate cruelly reunites them when Jiya steals Samrat’s ring to fund Shreya’s life-saving surgery, leading to humiliation, conflict, and heartbreak before the truth finally surfaces: Jiya is Samrat’s daughter, and Shreya is alive. As love, guilt, and redemption collide amid social cruelty and class divides, Aakhri Diya becomes a story of lost love, a child’s hope, and a broken family finding its way back to light.

title: Betrayed Heiress
description: Sakshi, who sacrificed everything for love, faces betrayal from her husband Vansh and his family. Humiliated and deceived, she rises with courage, reveals her true identity as the heir of SB Group, and reclaims her dignity and power.

title: College Romance Aur Dhoka
description: College Romance

title: One Last Chance [Hindi]
description:
One Last Chance is a gripping tale of love, choices, and the price of regret. A woman walks away from true love, only to realize later what she lost - as the man she left behind rebuilds his life in a deeply loving and affluent relationship. Passion, heartbreak, and high-stakes emotions collide in this drama that will keep you hooked at every turn.

An emotional rollercoaster and one of the most interesting watches of the year.

title: Lost In Love [Hindi]
description: Jab pyaar sirf ek emotion nahi, balki ek dangerous game ban jaata hai, tab har rishta ek nayi twist leta hai. Elle, Ethan aur Jannette ke beech ka yeh triangle sirf love story nahi, ek intense emotional rollercoaster hai jahan trust, betrayal aur revenge sab kuch hai. To ready ho jao ek gripping kahani ke liye jo har episode ke saath aur complicated hoti jaati hai. Abhi dekhna shuru kijiye.

title: Joker Ka Wild Card
description: Varun looks like a harmless, childlike man who has lost his memory, but behind that innocence lies a mysterious past and terrifying skill. When a ruthless gambling syndicate traps his wife’s family in an 8-crore debt, Varun steps onto the gambling table himself. With brilliant tricks and fearless mind games, he begins exposing the cheats of the underworld. But who is Varun really… and why does the gambling world fear the name Sikandar?

title: Dulhan Se Darling
description: Dulhan Se Darling is a fiery romantic drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Kritika Reddy, heiress of a billion-dollar empire disguised as a cleaning staff, crosses paths with ruthless billionaire Rihaan Bhatt, sparking a storm of clashes, secrets, and undeniable attraction. But when her duplicitous fiancé and his mistress plot against her, Kritika must rise from humiliation to power—finding both revenge and unexpected love.

title: Undercover Agent: Mission Narmada Jail
description: A disgraced RAW commando infiltrates a high-security Indian prison to expose a terror network, but discovers the man who ruined his father’s name and his nation’s honour has been hiding in the same cell all along.

title: Secret Prince
description: So, our hero, born into a super-rich family, is about to be named the next heir to their business empire. But according to their family tradition, the person taking the position has to learn the ropes for 3 months by working at another business, hiding their real identity. That's exactly what our hero does.. He hides who he is and starts working at a business family's place. That's where he meets our heroine, who's already engaged to someone else. Love starts blooming in his heart, too. Now, what's our hero going to do? Is he going to stick to the family tradition? Or is he going to give up the family's custom to marry his girlfriend

title: The Magical Husband
description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Veer, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Vaishali due to family greed and betrayal, turning two broken lives into an unlikely partnership. As conspiracies, poison plots, and humiliation surround them, Veer secretly uses his powers to protect Shaifali, while love slowly grows between duty, dignity, and destiny.

title: Billionaire Became Beggar
description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Became Beggar is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

title: The Great Indian Cook
description:
Samy and Sarath are childhood friends, but their sons, Kathir and Dev, become rivals at the family restaurant. After Samy leaves and Sarath dies, Dev blames Kathir, while Kathir rises from a small roadside stall with his talent.
When they face each other on the Great Indian Kitchen stage, will jealousy win, or will true talent prove itself?

title: Mechanic Billa: Return of the Racing Legend
description: After five years in hiding, a legendary racer disguised as a mechanic must return to the track to save his village, igniting a high-octane rivalry with the current world champion. Watch now!

title: Billionaire Heist
description: A billionaire with unlimited funds but no proof, Dharam Khurana is trapped in a system that refuses to believe him. As hours tick down and humiliation piles up, one decision changes everything. What begins as a simple plea turns into a dangerous game of power, ego, and survival.

title: Dad With A Dark Side
description: Aravind Varma is an ordinary cleaner. Anu, the CEO of Aditya Group of Hotels, develops feelings for him. Even though he has a son who is of marriageable age, will Aravind marry Anu? The story revolves around the hidden secret in the life of an ordinary cleaner.

title: Shattered Bonds [Kannada]
description: When railway ticket checker (TT/ TC) Ishwar Pratap retires after 40 years of honest service, his three biological children reveal their cruel indifference, forcing him and his devoted wife Rajni into a humiliating separation - until his adopted son Prem and a book of love poems expose the truth about family, sacrifice, and the price of unconditional love.

title: The Sweeper Billionaire
description: Tarun, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Sneha, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

title: The Street Beggar to Billionaire
description: The Street Beggar to Billionaire

title: Dhurandhar Shooter
description: Rohan, India’s best sniper, known as Gun Master G-9. After losing his mentor in a terror attack, Rohan gives up guns and hides his identity while working at a small shooting academy of his mentpr’s widow in Uttarakhand. When criminals, corrupt forces, and an international terror plan threaten an innocent family and the country’s future, Rohan must face his past. The story blends patriotism, sacrifice, family emotions, and revealing how a true warrior never stops protecting his people.

title: Still Waiting for Love [Kannada]
description: Still Waiting for Love

title: Secretary Rosie [Kannada]
description: She wasn’t just a secretary. She was temptation wrapped in silk, whispering promises that blurred the line between loyalty and lust. With every calculated smile, every lingering touch, she stepped deeper into his marriage—turning boardroom meetings into battles of desire, and home into a war zone. But how far would she go? To steal his property? To wear his wife’s crown? Or to seduce her way into a future where his empire bore her name alone?

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life [Hindi]
description: When enchantment mage Rein is dismissed from his guild after buffing all their gear, he reclaims every enhancement for himself. Armed with only basic equipment and stolen power, he embarks on an overpowered adventure from scratch.

🧡 ■ "eFootball™" - An Evolution from "PES"
It's an all-new era of digital soccer: "PES" has now evolved into "eFootball™"! And now you can experience the next generation of soccer gaming with "eFootball™"!

■ Welcoming Newcomers
After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

[Ways of Playing]
■ Build Your Very Own Dream Team
You have a plethora of teams that can be chosen as your Base Team, including European and South American powerhouses, J.League and national teams!

■ Sign Players
After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

・ Special Player List
Here you can sign special players such as standouts from actual fixtures, players from featured leagues, and legends of the game!

・ Standard Player List
Here you can handpick and sign your favorite players. You can also use the Sort and Filter functions to narrow your search.

■ Playing Matches
Once you have built a team with your favorite players, it's time to take them to the field.
From testing your skills against the AI, to competing for ranking in Online Matches, enjoy eFootball™ the way you like!

・ Sharpen your skills in VS AI Matches
There are a variety of Events that coincide with the real-world soccer calendar, including a "Starter" Event for those just starting out, as well as Events where you can play against teams from high-profile leagues. Build a Dream Team that fits the Events' themes and take part!

・ Put your strength to the test in User Matches
Enjoy real-time competition with the Division-based "eFootball™ League" and a wide variety of weekly Events. Can you take your Dream Team to the pinnacle of Division 1?

・ Max 3 vs 3 matches with friends
Use the Friend Match feature to play against your friends. Show them the true colors of your well-developed team!
Cooperative matches up to 3 vs 3 are also available. Get together with your friends and enjoy some heated soccer action!

■ Player Development
Depending on Player Types, signed players can be further developed.
Level up your players by having them play in matches and by using in-game items, then utilize the acquired Progression Points to develop them to match your playing style.

[For More Fun]
■ Weekly Live Updates
Data from real matches being played around the world is collated on a weekly basis and implemented in-game through the Live Update feature to create a more authentic experience. These updates affect various aspects of the game, including player Condition Ratings and team rosters.

title: A Man and a Gisaeng
description: A young man who was fired from his job for being unmanly decides to dress as a woman and work as a gisaeng. He gets proposals from several of his male clients including his former boss, Heo. He earns enough money to clear his gisaeng life and opens his own business with his friend Jeong-hui. Meanwhile his sister tells him that she is getting married. Later he finds out that her future brother in-law is the son of Heo. He doesn't know how to react. But Heo takes the man back to his company.

title: A Boss and a Babe
description: Cher, a vibrant aspiring pro-gamer, has just started his internship at a gaming company led by Gun, the uncompromising CEO. As they continue to grow closer both in and out of the workplace, what will become of their striking connection?
