title: Chyort s portfelem
description: The journalist of the regional newspaper "Raduga" Mikhail Makarov, a fearless author of accusatory fieletons, a principled fighter against slovenliness and mismanagement, sharply criticizes the editor-in-chief, who does not let his scandalous articles go to press or cut off his scandalous articles due to lack of facts. Once buying potatoes at the market, Makarov meets a young saleswoman who offers him to collect critical material on her collective farm for the next fieleton. Having gone on an editorial trip and convinced on the spot in all the facts about the rotting record crop of potatoes, the enthusiastic journalist prepares a devastating article. But, unexpectedly finding himself for a short time in the place of his boss, and faced with the real bureaucracy in the planned economy of various departments, Makarov changes his mind.

title: masakra w
description:
Amerykański western w wersji z polskim lektorem - Masakra w Dragoon Wells.

Oficer kawalerii jako jedyny ocalał z ataku Indian. Wraz z wozem pełnym więźniów i skazańców, przemierza terytorium wrogo nastawionych Indian.

Masakra w Dragoon Wells (1957)
Reżyser: Harold D. Schuster
Scenarzyści: Warren Douglas, Oliver Drake
W rolach głównych: Barry Sullivan, Dennis O'Keefe, Mona Freeman
Gatunek: western
Kraj: USA
Język: angielski
Data premiery: 28 lutego 1958 r. (RFN)
Miejsca kręcenia: Kanab, Utah, USA

Fabuła:
Oficer kawalerii, jedyny ocalały z ataku Indian, wraz z wagonem więźniów przemierza wrogie tereny indiańskie.

Recenzje:
"„Nie jestem obiektywny, bo mam z tym filmem osobiste wspomnienia. Jako nastolatek lubiłem kolorowe westerny z popularnymi aktorami. Dziś wolę czarno-białe klasyki. Latem 1956 roku przypadkiem trafiłem na plan zdjęciowy tego filmu w Utah. Widziałem, jak kręcono kilka scen z O'Keefe’em i Cabotem. Później obejrzałem film w kinie i zaskoczyło mnie, że fabuła jest bardziej złożona niż w typowych westernach z lat 50. Nie ma tu jednego bohatera – to historia wielu postaci. Polecam każdemu, kto lubi filmy z dobrze napisanymi postaciami i solidną realizacją. Szkoda, że trudno znaleźć ten film na DVD.”
Autor: hitt_dave na IMDb.com
 

„To nie jest prosty western. Kapitan kawalerii i więźniowie muszą współpracować, by przetrwać na terenie Indian. Aktorstwo stoi na wysokim poziomie, reżyseria jest solidna, a muzyka buduje napięcie. Film ogląda się z prawdziwą przyjemnością.”
Autor: bux na IMDb.com

title: Minna w Fina
description: A husband travels with his wife outside the country to have her treated for her illness while the children remain alone in the house. However, their problems increase due to their lack of discipline, which raises the concern of the parents, and here begins a conflict between the two generations after the arrival of the grandparents.

title: W Zappatore
description: Thirty three year-old Marcello Zappatore plays electric guitar for a Satanist Heavy Metal band in Lecce until one day he discovers... stigmata on the side of his rib cage! Part sci-fi, part fantasy, part family drama, W ZAPPATORE is an over-the-top Italian farce, taking on the age-old battle between Good and Evil... and Rock n Roll.

title: W Magazine: #Keywords
description: In Elizabeth Hummer's fashion week series #KEYWORDS the essential elements of the Spring 2016 collections are broken down for Diane von Furstenberg, Narciso Rodriguez, Phillip Lim, Vera Wang, and Altuzarra. Get behind-the-scenes glimpses of the shows and input from attending editors, front row celebrities and the models who grace the runways.

title: W pustyni i w puszczy
description: Fourteen year old Polish boy Stas Tarkowski and eight year old Nel Rawlison from England are kidnapped as the hostages by Arabic fanatics and taken to their religion leader. Then they manage to escape and try to return to their fathers. Children have a lot of dangerous adventures, meet two Black kids; Kali and Mea, who also help them, make a friendship with an elephant and help one Black's tribe. Finally they manage to return. Based on great novel, the same title by Nobel receiver (for all his literary output) Henryk Sienkiewicz.

title: Dimension W
description: In the year 2072, the world's energy problems seem solved by a network of cross-dimensional electric-field inductors called "coils" that extract energy from a seemingly infinite source.

title: Pamietnik znaleziony w garbie
description: The film is set in Silesia, a disputed piece of provincial real estate that has variably belonged to both Poland and Germany. This tragi-comic family saga opens in 1939. Ewald is called up to Polish army. Antek, his brother, stays et home, watching his beautiful sister-in-law with cow- eyed longing. Then, he decides to volunteer in Wehrmacht. However, Antek returns home in 1945 as NKVD officer. On the fateful night that the Soviet march into Poland he manages to consummate his lust, and Janek, a hunchback, is born. As Janek grows, the tensions between the boy and his father increase. The course of modern Poland, as it is shaped in those crucial years, parallels the familys changes, and the allegorical meaning of the film is brought into focus particularly through the chameleon-like transformations of the charismatic Antek, who becomes in succession, a priest, a German soldier and NKVD officer, a communist party official, an oppositionist, and finally a Western businessman.

title: Malcolm X
description: Biographical epic of the controversial and influential Black Nationalist leader, from his early life and career as a small-time gangster, to his ministry as a member of the Nation of Islam and his eventual assassination.

title: Twitter: The Movie
description: A short parody of the website X, formerly known as Twitter, inspired by the works of YouTuber David Lehre.

title: Astonishing X-Men
description: An alien species attempts to take over earth, but the X-Men are ready for anything.

title: X-Rated Queen
description: The story of a young woman from a small Polish town who escapes to West Germany and finds herself drawn into the world of adult entertainment.

title: 2x1
description: Noriko Yoshifuku, supposedly flu-stricken, hasn't attended "college" since the start of sophomore year. When two of her classmates, are sent to bring her homework, the two young men discover that Yoshifuku does not have the flu at all.

title: Beyblade X
description: A young boy who aims to be a professional Beyblade player. He aims to get to X Tower, where professional Beyblade players gather.

title: Y
description: 'Y' is a Marathi thriller explored through hyperlinked narrative. The film revolves around four parallel yet interwoven stories coinciding at times.

title: Contrabando y traición
description: Two criminals, Emilio and Camelia try to smuggle drugs into the USA.

title: Rocío y José
description: José is a 17-year-old Andalusian boy who strikes up a relationship with a girl his age, Rocío, during the famous pilgrimage of the same name that takes place in the Huelva town of Almonte. In that place, accompanying the carts and horses, they strengthen their love as they walk the path that will take them to the hermitage where the Virgin is found.

title: Y Swn
description: In 1979, when Margaret Thatcher's first government breaks a promise to establish a Welsh language television channel, a wave of civil disobedience follows. One man - Gwynfor Evans - threatens to starve himself to death unless the government comes good on its manifesto pledge. The reimagining of one of the most colourful chapters in contemporary Welsh history.

title: Psique y sexo
description: A movie in four parts. A frustrated woman finds love with a painter. A woman tries to seduce her subordinate when she takes him to her apartment. A woman who killed her husband falls in love with the gravedigger. The sexual awakening of two teenagers and the reaction of their parents.

title: Mosquita y Mari
description: After being assigned as study partners, two Chicana high schoolers find a bond that confuses them at times.

title: Héroes y demonios
description: Two young men meet at a psychiatric hospital, where they become friends willing to fight against injustice.

title: Tú y yo

title: A Candidate for a Killing
description: Nick Warfield is a speed boat racer hitching along the Mediterranean after his speed boat has been smashed up. He is picked up by Jacqueline Monnard who quickly gets him into a barroom brawl followed by prison.

title: A Year and a Day
description: An unusual story of The Flills who are a successful, well respected working class Glaswegian family who founded and run the local community centre. Mikey Flills is the backbone of the family, who selflessly keeps the family together and happy with his enormous charm and huge personality. But Mikey has many secrets, which lead to him leaving his family behind without any explanation. He returns a year later to make amends. He visits his fathers' grave to speak to him before he returns to his broken family to give them answers. Will he atone? What devastation will he find? How will the family react

title: A-Level
description: After getting through the O/L Examination with outstanding results, Anuththara with his friends eagerly look forward to experience their final years in school as seniors in the A/L class. They befriend Ahinsa and the other new girls who join their school. Ahinsa draws everyone's attention for her smartness as well as her cheerful yet mysterious behaviour. Her irregular school attendance and the rumours circulating about her, make the others suspect that there's a hidden story behind her cheerfulness.

title: A Circus Tale & a Love Song
description: A romantic circus performer leaves Mexico seeking love, landing in New Orleans where he falls for an exotic dancer - but her possessive ex threatens their chance at happiness.

title: A árvore
description: It centers on the artist's father, linking geographies, times, the living, and the dead with a metal sword.

title: A Love That Couldn't Survive-A
description:
On her 18th birthday, Emily Hunter wakes up in a luxury suite beside Victor Young, Philadelphia’s most sought-after bachelor. After their reckless night together, she discovers she is pregnant.
Victor and her wealthy father shower her with luxury, making her the most pampered expectant mother in Beverly Hills. But the perfect life is a cruel lie. An anonymous video reveals the truth: Victor is in a fake marriage with Emily, and his real lover is Isabella — the illegitimate daughter of Morgana Ashford, the mistress who caused Emily’s mother’s death. Her father colludes with them to seize control of the Hunter Group.
Abandoned, slandered, and physically harmed, Emily is left bleeding and helpless in a hospital. Just as she hits rock bottom, powerful tycoon Kai Thorne saves her and promises her unborn child will be his sole heir.
No longer a trapped “princess,” Emily fights back. Using her late mother’s will and Kai’s support, she exposes the conspiracy at the shareholder auction, reclaims her family fortune, and cuts ties with her traitorous father.
Victor is consumed by regret after losing everything, while Isabella and Emily’s father face ruin for their greed.
Emily later gives birth to a daughter, and Kai transfers massive assets to secure their future. She lets go of her painful past, stepping out of the shadow of manipulation to become the true master of her own fate, embracing a brand-new life.

title: Onde a Água Encontra a Terra
A Past, a Future and Destiny
description: An uncontrollable force of destiny controls a dirty politician's life leading him from a path of death to life.

title: A Minor
description: Nadi is interested in playing, but her father strongly opposes music, and this is where her problems begin.

title: Confundiram a Criada com a Senhora —— A Verdadeira Herdeira é Inalcançável
description: A bilionária Elisa está prestes a se casar com o namorado. Para apoiar a carreira dele, ela mantém um perfil discreto e vai ao aeroporto buscar sua futura sogra, Lola George. Esnobe, Lola confunde Lydia Harris, amante de Cody, toda produzida e cheia de bajulação, com a futura nora, a presidente do Grupo White. Ao mesmo tempo, toma Rachel pela amante e a humilha sem piedade.

title: A Compadecida
description: Clown tells the story of João Grilo, a rich couple's lively employee who cheats everybody in town: arranges a funeral for a dog, bribes the priest and the bishop into celebrating a mass in latin for the animal, and performs many other bizarre things. After he dies, he's submitted to a trial in Heaven, being judged by a black Christ, having the Devil as prosecutor and the Virgin Mary as his defense.

title: A Lovely Day for a Walk
description: It's a beautiful spring day in Central Park -- the sun is shining, birds are singing, flowers are in bloom. It's the ideal setting for an attractive young couple to have... the most frustrating date imaginable.

title: A Sage's Mind, A Modern Heart
description: Lively museum intern Ethan Stone bonds with a mystic ward at the tomb of Julian Wise — ancient China's most legendary strategist — and seemingly inherits his 1,800-year-old genius. Solving cold cases, outwitting rivals, and reinventing his hero's ancient inventions, Ethan wins scholar Claire Hart's heart while reviving history for modern audiences. His brilliance isn't magic — it's a lifelong obsession finally paying off.

title: A Diarista
description: Acclaimed comedy series about a clumsy and sassy cleaning lady and her daily tasks and occasional jobs.

title: A Flat
description: A spate of unexpected events jolted Rahul as soon as he landed from U.S. Now, Rahul finds himself trapped in his own flat, completely cut off from the world. The only companion he has is a ghost, a ghost that will not let go of him.

title: A Name Without a Place
description: While retracing his late-brother's footsteps through the Florida Keys, a sheltered young man stumbles upon the secret estate of a narcissistic recluse.

title: B & B
description: An out-of-work architect turns his house into a bed and breakfast hotel.

title: P & B
description: Pettersson and Bendel are both worn, run-down and broke. Despite this they decide to start a business and become rich. Unexperienced they are open to any deal. They tamper, scam and exploit loopholes that exist.

title: Dancing for Mr. B: Six Balanchine Ballerinas
description: Six of George Balanchine's finest stars, Maria Tallchief, Mary Ellen Moylan, Melissa Hayden, Allegra Kent, Merrill Ashley and Darci Kistler pay a moving tribute to the legendary choreographer and tell how he shaped them as dancers and influenced their lives.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description: Jamal passes through his 10th birthday, and in the process of 'becoming a man', which is what this milestone means, he tries to give up childhood things, including C Bear, his teddy bear. C Bear and Jamal talk to each other, and C Bear can create imaginary scenarios for Jamal - he shows Jamal what adulthood can mean, and how passing 10 does not mean that all of childhood must be abandoned.

title: What Is Love?
description: Showcases an trip to the Vatican, so that a couple can annul a Catholic marriage.

title: Snow Eagle Lord S1-S3
description: Snow Eagle Lord Dong Bo Xue Ying must rescue his imprisoned parents and defend the Xia clan from demon forces. He teams up with warrior Yu Jing Qui and teleporter Pu Yang Bo to fight the rising evil.

title: Home Run! My Ex Wants Us Back
description: Six years ago, Emma Collins was pregnant with Ethan Blake's child. To protect his dream of becoming a professional baseball player, she made him believe she'd betrayed him and walked away. She gave birth to their son, Noah, and raised him alone while caring for his heart condition. Six years later, they meet again. But Ethan's love has turned to hate. He will stop at nothing, using every ruthless trick, just to force Emma to stay by his side!

title: Tiovivo c. 1950
description: Madrid, the capital of Spain in the 50s, it is still in a latent postwar period. A carousel of several survivors try to make a living in a gloomy country.

title: M A N C A V E
It Started in Naples
description: Days before his wedding, a Philadelphia lawyer travels to Naples in Southern Italy to settle the estate of his late brother, only to find that he has an Italian nephew who is being cared for by his maternal aunt, a cabaret singer.

title: Africa Adventure
description: A true film account of a three-month safari in the big game hunting areas of the Dark Continent, undoctored with any faked plot or contrivance.

title: Forever and Ever
description: A renowned voice actress and a chemistry professor chance upon each other at the airport. They form a bond while conserving traditional crafts and weather storms together, deciding to be lifelong companions.

title: Nardebam-e Asman
description: The life and works of the Iranian mathematician and astronomer Ghiyath al-Din Kashani (1380-1429), who lived part of his life, under the Timurid ruler Ulugh Beg, as the designer, architect and director of the Samarkand observatory.

title: Gohar-e-Nayab
description: About a girl Goher Nayab (Gori) who moves to her uncle's houseafter her mother dies and her father remarries. There is no place for Goher Nayab.She is unwelcomed at heruncle's house and lives a life of acute suffering among waging tongues and rude behavior of people. She dreams of having a house she can call her own. Fate intervenes and she is married into a well-off family. But after marriage she suffers the ill-treatmentof her mother in law and realizes she will be thrown out of that house too. Gori gets pregnant but she doesn't want her child to live a disturbed life like hers. Finally she is rewarded. She learns that it's not concrete houses but love that makes life beautiful.

title: Gol e Naz
description: Two sisters, Golnaz and Golbahar, who lost their parents in an accident as a baby. They are given to the shelter and each of them is taken care of by a family. Golbahar (Shadi Pashang) was taken to the United States by her new family. Now, 28 years later, she finds out that she has a twin sister and returns to Iran to find Golnaz (Sepideh Mansour).

title: Nausherwan-E-Adil
description: A fair-minded emperor improves and introduces new laws, but ends up facing challenges when his son violates them.

title: Gol-e yakh
description: Abbas sends his wife ,Targol, to village in North to his mother but an earthquake happens and.

title: Mulheres e Milhões
description: Após ser cruelmente abandonado pela sua ex-namorada Wang Feifei, que foge com um herdeiro rico, Jiang Fan, Su Chen é humilhado e acaba se envolvendo em um acidente de carro. Essa tragédia desperta o misterioso "Sistema de Retorno Centuplicado", que recompensa Su Chen com 100 vezes o valor que ele gasta com mulheres. Com seu poder recém-adquirido, a vida de Su Chen se transforma enquanto ele conhece quatro mulheres fascinantes — Liu Qingyan, Su Wan'ning, Xia Linlin e Han Mengyao. Enquanto Wang Feifei e Jiang Fan zombam dele, acusando-o de ser "mantido", a ascensão de Su Chen ao topo acaba superando suas mais loucas imaginações.

title: F**King Amazing
description: "When you wake up in the morning, do you have a thought in your mind that makes you smile thinking that today is going to be fucking amazing?" If not you're probably working for someone else's dream. Damn! There is a tech revolution going on. You never had that many chances to find and do what you really love. Grab your computer. Do some research. Connect with other people. Act on your idea. Work hard. Fail. Learn. Meet more people. Work harder. Fail harder. Succeed. And change the world. This is a worldwide journey. This is the story of a global tech entrepreneur, Honor. This can be your story too.

title: F Troop
description: The misadventures of the staff and neighbors of a remote U.S. Army outpost in the Wild West.

title: Talento F, destino S
description: Por un accidente, Andrés, el joven amo del Abismo, representa a Reino Dragón en el juego de Terror. Todos pensaban que un talento nivel F, un débil sin esperanza, moriría. Hasta que el jefe de una mazmorra se arrodilló ante él...

title: G-Men from Hell

title: AC, proud ARMY! May pa-kilig mula kina Jungkook at J-Hope
description:
Peak summer season na! Trending ang mga out of town, beach pics sa feed. At ikaw na tamang scroll lang, napapa-"sana all" na lang, indeed. But don't you worry, mahaba pa ang buwan ng May. Siguradong may plot twist pa na oh-so-okay. I-shift na lang ang energy into good vibes kasama ang "It's Showtime" family.

Ito ang "sana all" na tatanggapin natin, though. Sabay-sabay tayong mapa-"sana all" sa haba ng hair ni AC Bonifacio. Nag-follow lang naman sa kan'ya sina BTS members Jungkook at J-Hope sa social media. OMG! Mga oppa!

Ngayong panahon ng Santacruzan at Flores de Mayo, rumampa ang mga escorts at reyna sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Walang nakatakas sa karisma ni escort Aljerou, na natural ang mga hirit at patawa, at in-interview pa si Vice Ganda. Kaya hirit ni Meme, baka kunin niya ito sa pelikula—hindi lang tayo sure kung bilang artista nga ba. Proud na ipinakilala ni Aljerou ang kan'yang real-life Reyna Elena, si Lian. Medyo selosa si GF, pero promise ni Aljerou, siya ang 'only one' sa kan'yang puso.

Feel na feel naman ni Mai ang ganda moment niya in her lovely gown. Beauty knows no age, dahil kahit mommy at almost 50 na, keri niyang panindigan ang crown. Bukod sa mahuhusay rumampa, good job din ang players sa game arena. Na-survive nila ang pinakabagong challenge ng 'You Gotta Lyric.’

Si escort Garry ang umabante sa jackpot round. Dahil pinaghahandaan ang pag-aaral ng mga kapatid, sa pag-asa ng POT, siya'y kumapit. Masagot kaya niya ang katanungan na katumbas ng P200,000?

Mula pa sa isa sa pinakamalalayong isla, Basilan, ang nagbukas ng bosesan ng mga taga-BARMM sa Tawag Ng Tanghalan. Papuri ang salubong nina Jonathan Manalo, Jed Madela, at Punong Hurado Louie Ocampo.

Masarap sa pandinig, masarap pa sa feeling while listening. Ganyan ang epekto ni Aarol, who energized the Madlang People with his "Feeling Good" performance. At tagos sa puso ang bawat letra ni Edison, na hinarana ang mga hurado sa awiting "Maging Sino Ka Man."

description: A philosophical adventure biopic, 08.20 is a contemporary story of a young Moscow photographer in search of meaning, contribution and purpose. He rejects a safe, well-fed and quiet future, then struggles to transcend his austere childhood. His goal: transform the surrounding Russian bleakness into vivid color photographs. To develop his artistic sensibility, a method: destroy the rational, the educated mind. Take risks, shoot heroin, experiment with sex and techno. His artworks grow, the Universe has his back. He dodges bullets, runs from cops and dupes his parents. To mature as a pro, he moves to Paris, the city of photography. Where he clashes with consumerism, post-modernism and the art establishment. So he amplifies the reckless habits, approaches the revelation. Until his new French girlfriend sways him towards comfort, advertising projects, money, health and family. Good fortune? Or a fatal mistake? Can he have it all? Or has he left the path of self-realization? Spanning 3 decades, the film portrays the work and doubts of a photojournalist, as he confronts the ethics of war photography, dives into music press awash with drugs, then photographs extreme sports (climbing, cycling, aerobatics and sailing), searching for his artistic core, questioning the boundaries between an artist and a sell-out. Shot in Moscow, Ural, Paris, Berlin, the Atlantic Ocean and the Alps; out of sequence, scene by scene, it assembles a puzzle of debauchery and sadness, of pleasure and sacrifice, of free will and fate. A dialogue of cultures, in English, French and Russian. A visually-stunning love story, with an abrupt and ambiguous ending.

title: Daily T
description:
Thomas J Elliott is a master filmmaker who has worked all over the world, creating multi award winning projects for some of the world's leading global brands, from Coca-Cola to Microsoft, Manulife, global advertising agencies and anywhere and everywhere in between.

Beyond his work in content and commercials, he has directed documentaries, television series and more recently he has branched off into feature films and streaming content.

He is the author of five award-winning, best-selling books on visual content and visual storytelling.

In addition to this he is a regular contributor to leading educational workshops and events all over the world, from massive events like VidCon to private workshops for universities, think tanks and global brands and agencies.

In this first of its kind series created exclusively for social media platform LinkedIn, Thomas shares his thoughts on crafting and creating films and visual content as well as a deep dive into the directing process that covers everything from selecting the right material, to working with actors and crew, on set process and getting your work completed and out there.

The series provides a unique insight into an established working director, his process, the reality of working with brands, agencies, production companies, actors and production partners.

It shows the audience real world examples they can use in their work immediately to improve the quality of their work and their output.

Episodes are released weekly Monday to Friday on LinkedIn and across other channels.

title: A mulher começa a guerra
description:
Quando a enfermeira Cindy se envolve em um tiroteio mortal entre a máfia, o implacável chefão do crime Allan D'Angelo salva sua vida ao declarar que ela é sua noiva. Agora, ela é prisioneira em seu mundo — vivendo em sua mansão, usando seu anel e desempenhando um papel que pode levar ela à morte.

O que começou como uma mentira desesperada para enganar seus inimigos se torna algo muito mais perigoso quando sentimentos reais aparecem. Enquanto famílias rivais se preparam para a guerra e as balas começam a voar, Cindy precisa escolher entre sua liberdade e a do príncipe das trevas que a clamou como sua.

Ela pensou que poderia acabar com a violência. Em vez disso, ela se tornou a faísca que acendeu tudo.

title: A. Constant
description: Two sisters, Camille and Madeleine, make up the story of a woman: Alice Constant, the servant of their grandfather who committed suicide at the age of 25.

title: A Crowned Love, A Forbidden Fate
description:
Isolde Winslow, a fallen princess, lives under house arrest with her mother—until Crown Prince Edmund Sinclair, her family's enemy, begins to show her unexpected kindness. Though she resists, their bond deepens... until Isolde flees the palace, only to be captured by rebels.
 When Edmund risks his life to save her, Isolde must choose: Can she trust the man whose bloodline destroyed hers? Or is their love doomed from the start?

title: A dokumentátor
description: Raffael is the rich owner of a video store. His girlfriend, the attractive Chip works there. They make some extra by making illegal copies of pornographic and horror movies. It is Rambo's duty to deliver the video cassettes to the customers. Raffael doesn't know Chip and Rambo are lovers.

title: A filmzenekirály
description: This documentary movie is about the marvelous life of the three times Academy Award winner composer Miklós Rózsa. He was a Hungarian born composer in the Golden Age of Hollywood and composed the music for such movies as Spellbound, Ben Hur, A Double Life, El Cid and Quo Vadis?

title: Found a Partner Not a Parasite
description: Stripped of his bond beast, Beastmaster Caleb survives by bonding with an alien symbiote with endless hunger for evolution. As Caleb seeks revenge, this bickering pair grows stronger with every beast they devoured and becomes humanity's last hope against the apocalyptic symbiote invasion.

title: A Return
description: In a Tunisian village El Omrane in Sidi Bouzid (283 km from Tunis), massive arrests against young people who demonstrated their right to work. The elders of the town decide to start a hunger strike. Hamza 12, helps us discover the village, between resistance and memory.

title: Give A Dog A Home Live!
description: GIVE A DOG A HOME LIVE. is dedicated to sharing the stories of animals available for adoption live from BFAS adoption Centers in New York, Los Angeles, Atlanta and Salt Lake City, and animal shelters across the country. The series will also include tips on numerous topics, including how to care for your new friend once you bring them home, in addition to surprise in-studio experts and fuzzy faced guests who will join Schachner live each week.

title: A Kinematográfus
description: The ciematographer on title is no other than János Tóth, who is still the role model and reference point for all Hungarian cinematographers. He has proven his unique talent in all cinematographic genres. In his unmissable features, shorts and documentary films, he set an example to his peers with his tight compositions and his art of light. His experimental cinematographic films, shot with the optics he developed, were far ahead of their time. Our portrait film explores the oeuvre of this exceptional cinematographic artist.

title: Student A
description: An introverted, timid high school student is treated as an outcast. At home, she lives in fear of her violent alcoholic father. She escapes into online role-playing. Things appear to look up when popular girl wants to become friends.

description: A mysterious sect manipulates fate to scam the innocent. When revenge driven Shangguan Chengming crosses paths with his enemy Jiang Feiyan again, he sets a trap, using deception against deceivers. title: A Devoted Wife Is Worth a Fortune
description: Two months after divorcing, Nolan Montgomery finds happiness with his new wife, Elena Rogers. Elena treats his mother and daughter as her own, running a tight ship at home. But their peace is shattered when Nolan's pregnant ex-wife, Monica Sterling, shows up, wreaking havoc on the Montgomery household. Using her pregnancy to move in, Monica bullies Elena, treating them like servants—even Nolan's mother and her own daughter. Nolan pours his money and energy into helping Monica, only for her to attempt fleeing with his cash when he faces a crisis. Fortunately, Elena steps in to save him. Nolan later discovers Monica's baby belongs to Trevor Sullivan. She had cheated before the divorce and only returned to steal Nolan's wealth. In the end, Nolan cuts ties with his ex and lives happily ever after with his beautiful, gentle wife, Elena.

title: A Resistance
description: Koreans fought both at home and abroad against the Japanese occupation, yearning for their nation's independence. The national protest, which lasted for at least two months beginning on March 1st, 1919, is now known as the March First Movement. The outcries of war prisoners chanting "Long Live Korean Independence. Hurrah!" soon influenced colonized civilians, resulting in a roaring chant and a wave of national flags around the streets. After returning from the capital, Yu Gwan-Sun, a young student, stirred her town to protest, leading to numerous deaths including those of her parents. Despite the loss of lives, her urge and desire to protest for freedom became her calling-not only for all Koreans but for the freedom of all people.

title: Zivot a doba soudce A. K.
description: The serial in thirteen parts about the life and time of judge A.K. tells an up-to-date, realistic and internally dramatic story of a young man struggling his way through the maze of civil law disputes typical of the present-day society. He has to try and understand each of the parties, and pronounce a judgment in keeping with his idea of justice. And he also must bear never-ending responsibility for the way his verdict impacts the painful spots in the parties' lives. Judge Adam Klos strives to understand not only the cases he deals with, but himself as well.

title: Lightning in a Bottle - A Festival Story
description: A diverse group of millennials have a life changing experience at a holistic California music festival, Lightning in a Bottle, in 2016. The festival plays out in real-time from their perspective as the present-day, quarantined, versions of themselves reflect on what the festival experience truly means, how the world has changed since, and what keeps them connected to this very day.

title: Bergman: A Year in a Life
description: Journeying through 1957, the year Bergman released two of his most acclaimed features (The Seventh Seal and Wild Strawberries), made a TV film and directed four plays for theatre, Magnusson has amassed a wealth of archive and contemporary interviews, along with a fantastic selection of clips from his vast body of work.

title: A Horse of a Different Color
description: The film explores a friend's discovery of the world from the perspective of Jeffrey Watkins; a blind, disabled advocate, struggling to be 'normal' in an able bodied abnormal world.

title: Charles A. Cannon: A Mind for Business, A Heart for People
description: In "Charles A. Cannon: A Mind for Business, A Heart for People," the story is one rooted in a commitment to a singular vision of success for a small Southern town. It's that vision and the resulting nationwide impact that makes the film an important piece of history. Step into the world of American families during Cannon's years as the largest home textile producer in the world.

title: What Is a Man Without a Moustache?
description: A young widow, an aging widower-returnee, and a priest from a bankrupt parish are struggling to come to terms with the post-war environment, complete with its prejudices, illusions, and unpleasant mentality. What follows is a romantic comedy set in rough landscape, about a woman who falls in love with a local priest. He is not blind to her love, but is unable to choose between the church and her, until the circumstances force him to make his choice.

title: A Horrorshow
description: An episodic horror anthology series. A collection of creepy short tales set in various time periods.

title: Emanuelle - A Woman from a Hot Country
description: A man and a woman (Whitman & Gemser), both with checkered pasts, hitch a ride together. While on the trip both begin to converse about their most recent relationship. Through flashbacks the 2 describe how their relationships became unraveled and why they are in their current situations. Near the end of the trip they realize they have much in common and a strong bond begins to develop.

title: When a Feller Needs a Friend
description: Eddie wears a leg brace and his mother will not let him play like the other boys. His hope is that a German doctor will be able to operate and fix his leg. When his cousin Froggie comes to live with his family, he is nice to Mr. and Mrs. Randall, but mean to Eddie. Uncle Jonas sees what is happening, but Eddie's parents do not believe him as Froggie seems so nice. Uncle Jonas tries to make Eddie tougher by teaching him boxing and baseball, but all it does is get Jonas thrown out of the house.

title: A Herança
description: The Heritage focus on the lives of two sisters, Maria and Luciana, who grew up unaware of the frightening reality manipulated by their family for their own good, making them live in different worlds of illusion. The older sister, Maria, is an innocent and idealistic woman who is not even able to imagine the crimes committed so she could enjoy her privileged lifestyle. However the younger sister, Luciana, is a hedonistic, cynical and emotionally dysfunctional person, that uses sex and drugs to hide herself from responsibility and fears. Neither Maria nor Luciana are prepared when they suddenly inherit their grandfather's business and end up in a dangerous game of intrigue, manipulation and mystery. The Heritage will also discuss the future of water and the preservation of lands for conscious use. A social inheritance from the past, with nuances around the interests that affects all of us. "YOUR HERITAGE ISN'T MONEY, YOUR HERITAGE IS A SOCIAL COMMITMENT"

title: A Dragon Tamer in a Dragonless World
description: At my graduation ceremony, I changed my class and unlocked a 3S-level profession, Dragon Tamer. The only problem? Dragons went extinct over a hundred years ago.

title: A Little Girl in a Big City
description: Small-town girl Mary Barry wins a beauty contest and goes to New York to meet D. V. Cortelyou, the magazine's publisher. Greatly taken by young girl, Cortelyou arranges for her to live with Dolly Griffith, a woman of questionable reputation who often aids him in his wicked schemes of blackmail and seduction. During a party seemingly in Mary's honor, Cortelyou obtains some apparently compromising evidence with which to blackmail Mrs. Young, the wife of a wealthy broker; Cortelyou then makes rough advances toward Mary, and one of his assistants, Jack McGuire, gives him a good beating. Threatened with blackmail, Mrs. Young turns in desperation to Jack for help. Jack and Mary attempt to trap Cortelyou in a net of his own making, but the blackmailer is too smart, outwitting Jack and abducting Mary. Cortelyou also kidnaps Mrs. Young, keeping her and Mary in a deserted house. Jack learns of their whereabouts and arrives with the police. Cortelyou is arrested, Mrs. Young is saved from the consequences of scandal, and Jack proposes to Mary.

title: A Profetisa
description:
Eis a lenda:
Na Antiguidade, a vidente Elara Valente, para salvar o povo da calamidade, desfez sua própria divindade em doze fragmentos — o Olho Onisciente, que penetrava os desígnios do céu; o Sopro Divino, que desafiava a morte; o Guerreiro Eterno, invencível —, dando origem às doze grandes casas aristocráticas.
Sessenta anos depois, ela retorna. De cabelos brancos até os ombros e com um véu negro sobre os olhos, em sua forma mortal.
O comandante de ferro Xavier Cael é designado para vigiá-la. Mas, passo a passo, torna-se seu principal guarda-costas… e seu mais devoto crente.
Desta vez, ela não vem apenas para recolher os fragmentos.
Vem para reescrever as regras deste mundo.

description: After her parents' divorce, Lin Yujing moves to a new city and becomes seatmates with Shen Juan, a withdrawn student repeating a year. A year later, they reunite at university, where Lin Yujing helps Shen Juan confront his past and heal, while also discovering her own path in life.

title: Qalb-e Yakhi
description: At the end of an adventurous night, Attila - a gang boss- is thrown to his death from a building in Tehran. Shahrokh, a famous archaeologist is arrested for Attila's murder. Upon conviction, Shahrokh becomes cell-mates with Hamed, a man convicted of murdering his pregnant wife - Shiva- who is suffering from amnesia. Sayyeh, Shahrokh's daughter, joins forces with Mehran- a fellow history enthusiast-to try and clear her father's name. As the cat and mouse game continues, it comes to light that the illegal transfer and sale of a container of highly precious antiques seems to be at the heart of things. Is Shahrokh truly innocent? What is Mehran's real agenda? What is Hamed hiding? Is Sayyeh's only interest saving her father? As the clock counts down towards the zero hour, the story unravels, unmasking many of the characters' deceit as well as the scheme behind the greatest heist in Iranian history...

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Pak na pak ang mga kandidatang tumalak sa Miss Q and A Weekly Finals. Dahil sa malakas na cheer ng Madang People, napa-"and I thank you" sina Elthon Bequio, Trixie Gomez, Gabriela Duevall, Queen Sam Ri, Freda, at Kathryn Fernando Poe, Jr.

Ang mga accla, nagbardagulan at bumuo ng kani-kanilang grupo. Pero at the end of the competition, nangingibabaw pa rin sa kanila ang nahanap na bagong sisterhood... at may nahanap din na pag-ibig? Si Gabriela, na-love at first sight sa 'poganda' na si Queen Sam Ri. At totoo ba ang balita na may isang lasing na kandidata?!

Ang Top 4 na sina Sam Ri, Elthon, Freda, at Gabriela ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At mula sa apat, dalawa lang ang nag-face off sa Beklamation. It's Sam Ri versus Elthon sa katanungan na, "Sa panahon ngayon anong mas nakakatakot, katangahan o kasamaan?"

Talak ni Sam Ri, mas nakakatakot ang katangahan dahil ito ang dahilan kung bakit marami ang nabibiktima ng fake news. "May mga taong matatalino pero nagtatanga-tangahan kaya nadadakip sila at napapaniwala ng mali," sabi ni Sam Ri.

Mula NCR, sumugod sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang Madlang Players na nangtatrabaho sa printing shops. May isang player ba na magpapa-tarpaulin ng "congrats" dahil na-hit ang jackpot?

Ay, nakaka-in love talaga! Nakisali pa sweet-sweet-an sina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga, na pinakilig ang Madlang People sa kanilang 'rainy moment' na eksena!

Pagkatapos ng It's Giving, You Gotta Lyric, at Laro Laro Pick rounds, ang joy ay kumapit kay player Joy.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, dumami ang 'boyfriend' sa studio
description:
Sabi nga nila, after the rain there's a rainbow na naghihintay. Pero hindi pa man natatapos ang buhos ng ulan, kinulayan na ni Heath Jornales ang ating mga buhay sa karisma niyang taglay. Isang kilig harana at magandang balita ang hatid ng "PBB Collab 2.0" Kapuso 2nd Big Placer.

Nagningning ang tatlong kandidata na nagpatalasan ng wit sa Miss Q and A segment. Ready to dominate the 'queendom' of talak sina Xantie, Kendra, at Lancy Empleo. 

Rain or shine, tuloy rin ang puksaan at kulitan ng paborito nating trio sa FUNanghalian, sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Gets na ni Meme Vice ang galawan ng mga kaibigan, kaya nang mapag-usapan ang mga ibong 'parrot,' si Meme na mismo ang bumitaw ng punchline at tinawag ang sarili bilang 'panot.' 

Samantala, sa Wit Lang round ang punta nina Xantie at Lancy kung saan hinarap nila ang magkaibang pageant questions. Bahagyang kinabahan ang mga kandidata, but the effort is appreciated. Besides, nagbigay ng advice si hurado Nicole Cordoves for their improvement. 

Hindi lang candidates ang nag-attempt na sungkitin ang puso ng judges, dahil maging si Ryan Bang ay give na give sa mga jokes as his way to the heart of hurado Max Collins. Kaya para makuha ang loob ng mga kaibigan ni Max, nagpa-impress na rin ang cutie Koreano pati sa ibang hurado.

Kung malamig ang panahon, mainit naman na pinaglabanan sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang POT money na P250,000. Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si player Aubrey, isang cashier na nagbahagi ng karanasan sa mga scammer. Malakas naman ang dating ni player Darren, kaya si Jackie Gonzaga biglang longing. 

Sinuwerte nang todo si Maricel, na nabunot ang pangalan para sa jackpot round matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players. Naging maingat si Maricel sa pagpili, at naging wais hanggang sa huli.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, ipinakilala ang girlfriend of 9 years!
description:
Sa "It's Showtime" entablado they're always getting fiercer and fiercer with their new single "Spider." Here comes DNA, ready to slay! Ang singing trio nina Tasha, Julia at Ezri, nagpasikat sa harap ng Madlang People.

Ang pag-ibig, wala 'yan sa edad o kasarian. Kapag tumibok ang puso, huwag nang itago. Ipagsigawan ang damdamin! Ang feelings, aminin! Parang mga Miss Q and A candidates na hindi nagpapigil sa self-expression at pagtalak para marinig ng buong nation.

Mega slay sa pagrampa at talakan na havey ang queens na sina Francyne Astronomia, Kiana Ortega, at Dha-Dha Aringo.

Si Francyne na softie girlie, idol si Overtime Diva, Miss Trina. As a student, hate na hate niya 'yung mga kagrupo na palaging late. Si candidate 3, Dha-Dha, ipinakilala ang kanyang girlfriend of 9 years na si RR.

Sina Dha-Dha at Kiana ang umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talino at creativity sa mga tanong na mapaglaro't nakakalito. Mas nagustuhan nina hurados Max Collins, Michael Sager, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kiana, kaya siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Humataw nang wagas at napasigaw nang malakas ang Madlang Players mula San Jose, Navotas. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, malakas din ba ang swerte nila?

Malakas talaga ang chemistry ng DaCkie! Madlang People ay kinilig sa eksena nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. May pananagutan na?! Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro), nami-miss si Memerimar (Vice Ganda). Sobrang longing naman 'yan! Ang ating leading man, naghanap ng bagong Memerimar—walang iba kundi si Ryan Bang!

Sina Enteng at Mayang, parehong naka-survive sa You Gotta Lyric. Pero sa 'Laro Laro Pick,' one point lang ang kinailangan ni Mayang para umabante sa jackpot round kung saan nagkaroon siya ng pagkakataon na manalo ng P150,000.

title: Making Sh*t Up
description:
This film takes you behind the scenes in the timeline of a dynamic and ambitious young conceptual artist, from his "Clearance Sale" of a lifetime's work at ArtLA, to weeks of dispensing therapy at the Whitney Biennial, to a near-death injury on Miami's Biscayne Boulevard and the mindset that followed. Includes detailed on-site action at art installations and performances, with spirited opinions from celebrated artists and art world professionals about measuring the success and value of conceptual art.

The film is narrated with spirited, candid commentary by important artists and art professionals such as legendary conceptual / performance artists Marina Abramovic and Vito Acconci on the highs and lows of a conceptual art world with uniquely difficult career choices, by famed New York Magazine Senior Art Critic Jerry Saltz on what is and isn't conceptual art and how Rodriguez measures up, author Steven Henry Madoff about Rodriguez service aesthetics achievements, and celebrated New York art blogger C-Monster.net, who experienced the artist, face- to-face and alone, locked inside his therapy cube.

title: Podvodnaya lodka T-9
description: The Great Patriotic War. The Soviet submarine T-9, having passed through the minefields of the North Sea, penetrates into the enemy port. Sailors sink enemy transport ships, but soon find out that they were late - enemy troops and weapons have already been unloaded and sent to the front. Captain Kostrov finds himself in a situation where the combat mission is almost impossible, but he must complete it - for him it is a matter of honor or dishonor.

title: U ime zakona

title: Chopped U

title: U-Sport

description: Based off of the video game, on an island off the coast of Japan, Ryu, a martial artist, was given an invitation and some American money from his friend Ken Masters, telling him to come to the United States. Ryu arrives in San Francisco and Ken picks him up from the airport. Only to find out that Ken is rich and a defined martial artist himself. One night both Ryu and Ken were out scouting San Francisco for bars. Then, Ken flirts with somebody's girlfriend and gets into a fight. Ken has defeated the person. Only to find out that it was a partner of Air force pilot Guile. Ryu fights him, but was defeated easily. Ken then finds Guile and was too defeated. Ken then realizes that guile was a fighter of thew likes that Ryu and Ken has not seen before, Guile was a Street Fighter. So, both Ryu and Ken decided to set out to the world to learn the ways of the street fighter. Then, they get tangled up into a conspiracy involving a criminal organization.

title: Madame X
description: The movie chronicles the life of a young woman caught in the middle of an ugly war between her fiance and his father.

title: Amor y venganza
description: Young woman miraculously rises from runway model to internationally-acclaimed film star in a few months' time because she's sorta pretty and stuff. Then she decides to get even with an ex-boyfriend who left town for a job and forgot about her.

title: Fuerte y afortunada
description: Fuerte y afortunada

title: Y++
description: A series of sketches about the miseries of life in the 21st century and its effects on the human condition.

title: Carne y arena
description: Based on true accounts, the superficial lines between subject and bystander are blurred and bound together, allowing individuals to walk in a vast space and thoroughly live a fragment of the refugees' personal journeys.

title: La Habana y Barcelona. Esplendor y Ruinas
description: Havana and Barcelona have much in common. The Catalan Indians built extensively in Havana and you can also see many similarities in Barcelona's Paseo de Gracia or in the uptown's grand houses. Nowadays, Barcelona has become home to many talented Cubans: artists, musicians, doctors and unique but ordinary people. In this film, they sing, dance and explain their experiences in Barcelona, and how much they miss their own land. They get excited, cry and laugh. They tell us how they have adapted to life in this brotherly country, but different, colder and more formal. They talk about the special period caused by the fall of the Berlin Wall, and also about medicine and Afro-Cuban culture.

title: Ayer y hoy
description: Two women from the same family, one from 1830 and the other from 1930, the first subject to the rigor of the customs of her time and the other in an atmosphere of independence and freedom.

title: Nina y Laura
description: An essay on grief.

title: Sal y Pimienta: El show de Flora y Hortensia
description: Two spinster old maids and perverts harass gallants and TV stars to marry them.

title: 101-y kilometr
description: A semiautobiographical film about a newly released prisoner who dreams of becoming a writer.

title: Seis y medio
description: In Six and a half a man and a woman debate, amaze each other, discover love and ponder on it from a fresh perspective: from a 6.5 level. It represents an ironic and unabashed reflection, born from a couple born from the remains of two previous failed relationships which they have not completely got over yet. Among discussions and theories on life, unfaithfulness is aired, terms and conditions to be fulfilled are written, a thousand concepts concerning love are defined...They love each other while actively focused on their previous loves. The least settled couple it could seem. And yet they find it difficult to break up. Could it be because they love each other six and a half?

title: Almejas y mejillones
description: Rolondo is a biologist who has rented a house in Tenerife to conduct a research on the sexual behavior of mussels. Upon arriving, he discovers that the house is inhabited by Paula, a woman characterized by disorder and debauchery. Over time Rolondo ends up falling in love with Paula. But there is a problem, she likes women.

title: Samy y yo
description: Samy Goldstein, a writer for a television program, is surrounded by an oppressive female environment. Then decides to resume his passion for literature. Meet Mary, a beauty in crisis. From there a series of misunderstandings will happen.

title: Conecta y Canta
description: A musical reality show where music meets child and youth talent from all over Mexico.

title: Gen-Y Cops
description: After a lethal American attack robot, RS1, is unleashed onto the mean streets of Hong Kong, Asia's funkiest crime-fighting team finds themselves on the wrong side of then law.

title: Y que patatín, y que patatán
description: Five episodes that reflect a critical look on the universe of children. An ironic metaphor about the training of children and how they respond to limiting situations in their lives.

title: Amor y Mentira
description: Andrea, una universitaria, quedó embarazada de Mario, quien fingió ser pobre por una apuesta. Al ser "condenado a muerte" (él era en realidad el Señor de la Guerra), Andrea se hizo cantante para salvarlo. Al descubrir la verdad, usó una máscara; Mario, sin reconocerla, la humilló. Demasiado tarde, entendió su error.

title: Fe, esperanza y caridad
description: The movie consists of three separate segments, each dealing with faith, hope, and charity.

title: Waldo y los Numerolocos
description: WALDO Y LOS NUMEROLOCOS, is a TV show for children in which preschoolers learn to think and resolve everyday problems through the development of mathematical skills while enjoying the adventures and stories of the actors and performers of the Infinity Circus.

title: Yo y mi mariachi
description: A very tender story that will make you laugh and cry, on top of being amazed. A film that demonstrates love knows no barriers.

title: Z-Mom
description: A woman's family trip to a private island turns into a zombie outbreak. Her loved ones become infected, but she survives. Determined to save her family and others, she chooses to combat the zombie pandemic rather than join them.

title: Z milosci
description: A young married couple decide to take part in a porn movie for financial reasons but are not aware of the consequences of their decision.

title: Láska z pasáze
description: A young window cleaner turns into an apartment burglar tipster. Will he be able to start a new, more honest life?

title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
description: Grieving her sister Shiloh's death, Jax Hunter bonds with Shiloh's bold friend Luce. Together they tackle dangerous Mount Kwan in Thailand. When a rockslide traps them on a narrow plank 4,000 feet up, Jax must face her fears to survive.

title: Z Storm
description: This is a story about the biggest financial fraud attempted in Hong Kong, directed at the Government of Hong Kong and involved all 7 million Hong Kong citizens... no one is free from the scheme. Within the four decades of guarding Hong Kong's financial integrity, the ICAC has never come across an opponent so huge and so well organized as in the Z Torrent file... shadowy figures from the underworld of South America, Italy and Europe all ready to plot against the estimated 150 million dollars of Hong Kong citizens' tax money which was pooled in a fund called the WELFARE FUND. High profile chartered accountants, high ranking law enforcers, power lawyers, the super entrepreneurs; they all have their shares of play but none can really grasp the big picture; they are there only for what they desire most. When the wife of an up-rising star Superintendent of police force reported his corruption simply out of bitterness for being ill-treated, little did she know she is about to pull the head string from a very well weaved web of deceive, greed, sex, power, and last but not least, fear. The ICAC agent LOK who took charge of the simple complaint felt otherwise... it's his passion for justice that has been driving him all these years in the battle against bribery and corruption, even after losing his beloved wife. Further investigation soon revealed many unanswered questions and loose ends...the death of an ex-godfather status accountant of Hong Kong, the threats to even the seemingly harmless witnesses and informers, and the surfacing of a mysterious lady that has all connection with LOK's wanted list but with a background as simple and as tragic as a girl next door with terminal illness... As Lok dug deeper into the web, he is being hunted by trained foreign mercenaries; a tactic very seldom or never heard of in the history of Hong Kong's underworld! description: Scientists offer insight into how and where a 10.0 megaquake could strike. This two-hour History special explores one of the most deadly and perplexing mysteries that surrounds planet earth: huge megaquakes. title: The Eternal Zero
description: The story of Saeki Kentaro, who continues to fail the National Bar Examinations and lose sight of the goal of his life, and his old sister Keiko, who is a freelance writer looking up their grandfather Miyabe who died in the Pacific War as a Kamikaze pilot. Miyabe had an astute ability as a pilot of fighter planes, but he was extraordinarily afraid of death. His two grandchildren started wondering why he applied for the Kamikaze corps. Revealing Miyabe's unexpected title of "genius yet coward", they unveil a surprising fact which has been sealed for over 60 years.

title: The Zero Years
description: Today as tomorrow and as yesterday. Four women, who have been not been sterilized and are under constant toxic restraint and surveillance, are serving their term in a government-run brothel. Their duty is to have sex with their customers without remorse. The relations between them are at a critical point; food and water are scarce, their house is rotting and ready to collapse. Nothing on the outside exists any more. Nightmarish visions, simulated miscarriages and rapes, injections and nausea all make up their daily routine. Yet their dream they have been not been sterilized by the State. there goal is to have a child. One day, one of their customers disappears. The interrogations begin.

title: Zero Zone
description: Zero Zone is film journey to the Ukraine's Eastern front where during late 22' the Ukrainian Armed Forces liberated villages and cites from Russian occupation. The film portrays the reality of a cross section of civilians who survived the Russian occupation and are now faced with rebuilding their lives after having lost everything. In their own words we hear of their experiences, learn from their suffering and come to understand up close the the scars that the Russian occupation left on the lives who have lived through the wholesale destruction of their communities. While at heart the film is reflection on the war by those closest to it, Zero Zone also captures life on the front lines where they daily battle of the war is talking place, across a landscape and in trenches that is more reminiscent of the World War II than anything happening today. Through interview portraits with soldiers, commanders, and civilians we will hear their thoughts on the war and what they must do on a daily basis not only to survive but to fight for the freedom of their homeland.

description: Izu Ojukwu's Power of 1 is now available on Amazon Prime Video for viewers in the US and UK. The political thriller, which is partly inspired by 2 Baba's shelved 2017 protests stars Alexx Ekubo in the lead role of Justin Aba, a socially conscious afro-pop artiste with a large following. When Justin Aba decides to use his influence to stage a protest against the policies of the incumbent government, he is drawn into a game of politics he didn't bargain for. This film shows the twists, turns, and intrigue of a proposed protest march called by an influential pop artiste, that shook the socio-political landscape of Nigeria to its very foundation. Nerves are stretched to breaking point as the decision to take ownership and execute the protest throws up intriguing reactions from security operatives, political players, hustlers and opportunists Power of 1 stars Ramsey Nouah, Anne Idibia, Jide Kosoko and Michelle Dede. The film was released in cinemas nationwide last December and has played in theatres in the UK and US.

title: 4x4
description: When Ciro, a thug, breaks into a high-end 4x4 to steal the stereo, he gets trapped inside, as it turns out that the car has a security system that prevents any sound inside the car to get communicated to the outside, and hence Ciro's cries for help are not heard. Is there another way out for him?

title: 4 x 4 Reports
description: This was a BBC1 prime time current affairs show in a magazine style format. The title refers to four reporters on four angles of one big story. The concept was to have big name reporters or experts on the subject they were best known for.

Samar, a 2nd-year medical student, wonders if the soul has weight. He asks his professor for permission to conduct an experiment to measure it, but his professor refuses, citing it as inhuman and against the law.

title: Persona4 the ANIMATION
description: A young man, Yu Narukami has moved from Tokyo to Inaba to stay with his uncle and cousin, while his parents are away on business. However, after several murders shake up the sleepy town, things get crazier when he discovers the mysterious "Midnight Channel," and the ability to enter TVs. Accompanied by his friends, Yu explores another world inside the TV, that seems to be connected with the murders. They also discover the ability to summon 'Personas', their 'other selves', whose power they can use to fight the shadows that inhabit the TV world. The murders, the Midnight Channel, the world inside the TV, and Personas. Yu and his friends fight to figure out how they're connected, and to solve the case before it's too late.

title: The Social Trap: 5 Women vs the Big 5
description: Adolescents who are connected to their smartphones for more than 5 hours a day are 66% more likely to suffer suicidal symptoms than those who use it for 1 hour a day. Currently, 44 U.S. states are suing Meta, blaming it for the malaise of an entire generation. Facing tech giants like Meta, TikTok, X and Snapchat, five women decided to take action. Alexis, a former screen addict, sued Meta, accusing it for promoting suicide. Elisabet, a mother of three, mobilized 10.000 parents, leading to a ban on smartphones in school. Sofia, a psychiatrist, treats minors addicted to screens. Laure, a lawyer, is fighting to change laws that protect digital giants.Through their stories, the film reveals a harsh truth: regulation technology is not just a social issue - it is a matter of public health and safety.

title: 7 More Days in the Tank
description: A gifted stand-up comedian and talented U.S. Paralympic soccer player, Josh Blue refuses to bow to any of the challenges that come from living with cerebral palsy. He jokes, "I realize that people are going to stare so I want to give them something to stare at." He uses his self-deprecating sense of humor to defy stereotypes and encourage others to overcome their pre-conceived notions about disabled people. Blue - who was born in Cameroon, West Africa, and raised in St. Paul, Minnesota - got his start in comedy while pursuing a B.A. degree in creative writing from Evergreen State College in Olympia, WA. He now calls Denver, Colorado "home". In addition to guest-starring on Comedy Central's "Mind of Mencia," Blue has been making audiences laugh in top comedy clubs, theaters, colleges campuses and corporate events all over the country. At the 2004 Las Vegas Comedy Festival, he won the $10,000 Grand Prize at the Royal Flush Comedy Competition. In 2005, he earned rave reviews on the college circuit and a nomination for "Best Diversity Event of 2006." Describing his comedy as "spastic and engaging," Blue wanted to be on "Last Comic Standing" to "make people aware of the fact that people with disabilities can make an impact." Apparently he was right; on August 9, 2006 he won Last Comic Standing 4. In addition to being a stand-up comic, Blue is also a U.S. Paralympic soccer player, and he participated in the 2004 Paralympic Games that took place in Athens, Greece. The Paralympics, held two weeks after the Olympics, are the world's second largest sporting event. In "7 More Days in the Tank", Josh Blue returns to Denver for a stellar homecoming performance at the historic Gothic Theater. Recorded three days after his Last Comic win, the show had sold out three weeks before. Referring to the recent "liquids" scare on air travel, Josh asks himself: "Josh Blue, you just won Last Comic Standing. What will you do now?" "I thought I'd take down an airplane with shampoo!"

title: Language of Love
description: A modern advanced film about sexual education an behaviour based on the clinical research made by famous American and Swedish doctors. The film centres around a panel; Inge and Sten Hegeler, Maj-Brith Bergstroem-Walan and Sture Cullhed, all well known, reputable experts, who have devoted their scientific studies to the various fields of sexual life. The film deals with all kinds of problems connected with the sexual relationship of people. Whilst every question is discussed by the panel., the film illustrates; the difference between male and female sexual organs and their functions, positions, and authentic coition whereby a split screen system is used enabling us to see the various reactions in different parts of the body. In connection with this as well as in other parts of the film, diagrams and animations are used to simplify the understanding of the complicated reactions which occur when a person is under sexual stimulus. The panel also discusses the role of sex in society, the question of prejudices and taboos, sex in clothes, sex in art, etc. etc.

title: Putting Lipstick on a Pig
description: Paivi is in her 50's and lives on Aland, an island in Finland with 30 000 people. We have our own government which can decide some things independently of the Finnish government: taxes, hunting, gambling etc. Paivi is a single mother and when her boys move out she is alone. She looks for company online and finds gambling. She gets addicted. She is an accountant and has access to money. Things go out of hand. Suddenly she has lost 819 000 - of her clients money! She is caught and it is a big scandal. She tries to commit suicide but gets jail. The clients are angry, they trusted her! It gets worse. It turns out she lost it all to the local gambling company. They hold a monopoly license to prevent from addiction and criminality - exactly what they didn't. The money went to the local government and they distributed it to the people: to football associations, research etc. It all turns into a money laundry case, the first in Finnish legal history to involve a gambling company. But the government refuses to pay back the money which make Paivis former clients furious. The movie had a preview on Aland where it ran for four days and won the audience award. Public opinion became strong and the government now have to plan on how to pay back and how to prevent this from happening again. But people get addicted to gambling everyday. Right now someone is losing everything. Right now, a gambler filled with guilt tries to kill herself. This is just the story of one gambler.

Chronicling the trials and tribulations of three young Tamil men. A bright underachiever, the impressionable 23-year old Anpu, who lives with his no-nonsense disciplinarian father. Trapped in a self-perpetuating cycle of isolation, Anpu finds salvation with a local gang. A charismatic gang leader Kumar, who maintains a strong sense of comradely and a code of honour among his members. Gang life is not something he enjoys nor he chose, but circumstances forced him into it and he is waiting for an opportune time to get out. And, far removed from them is an ambitious student Ahilan, who has managed to surmount enormous challenges in life through his positive outlook and determination. They have treaded very different paths in their lives, yet their fates become inexorably tied to each other's. Anpu's involvement in Kumar's gang blossoms into a strong friendship between the two, based on trust and respect. Former classmates and friends, Ahilan and Anpu have grown distant over time due to a girl in their lives. These young men's stories couldn't be more different, yet one thread links them all. All of them are victims of the brutal civil war in Sri Lanka. That fateful bright Saturday starts like any other, and no one could have predicted the chain of events that are about to unfold that will change their lives forever.

title: Ah! My Goddess: Flights of Fancy [English] S1-S2
description: Set one year after Aa. Megami-sama!. The song may say thank heaven for little girls, but whom is college student Morisato Keiichi supposed to thank when three honest to goodness Goddesses move in and take over his life? And should he really be all that grateful? After all, according to most mythologies, relationships between mortals and immortals usually leads to mortifying complications, so we're already talking about an extremely mixed blessing. And when a fourth Goddess suddenly appears, that blessing quickly becomes a curse. Keiichi's new friends may be trying to help, but sometimes Belldandy, Skuld, Urd, and Peorth seem less concerned with Keiichi's safety than they are with establishing a pecking order and ownership rights. The delicate celestial balance that exists between human and goddess is thrown into complete and utter chaos.

title: Ima ai ni yukimasu
description: Yuuji is still a first-grade student, he is having a very hard time understanding what has happened to his mother and the fact that she won't be coming back. At the very beginning , the voice of the late mother is reading from a picture book that she wrote for Yuuji before she died. It is about a mother who dies, but promises to return when the rainy season comes. Yuuji believes in this story and thinks that his mother will come back when the rainy season comes. And surprisingly - she actually does. When it begins raining on a June morning, Yuuji runs out into the forest to the special place where he used to play with his mother. His father, Takumi chases after him to get him to go to school. When they arrive at the old ruined building where they used to play, Yuuji's mother, Mio is waiting there completely alive and healthy, but she has no memory of them or anything that occurred during her life.

title: My Sibling's Romance China
description: Four pairs of biological siblings move into a shared house to find love under each other's watchful eyes. title: Ai cao
description: A woman who believes she chose an unconventional path in her life is startled to find her children are stepping farther beyond society's boundaries in this drama from Taiwanese filmmaker Hsiu-Chiung Chiang. Ai-tsao (Li-li Pan) is a widow who is nearly 60 years old; her husband, over twenty years her senior, has been dead for nearly two decades, and Ai-tsao's life has settled into a comfortable routine of looking after her elderly mother and doting on her two adult children. Ai-tsao had a strong independent streak when she was young and struck out on her own over the objections of her parents, but she's not quite as willing to accept that her children have chosen lives different from her own. Ai-tsao slowly comes to the realization that her son is gay and struggles to come to terms with his lifestyle, but it's even more difficult for Ai-tsao when she discovers her daughter is going to be the unwed mother of a mixed-race child.

title: Ai no onimotsu
description: Jozaburo Araki is the head of a famous family-owned wholesale pharmaceutical store with a well-established history. At present he is the Minister of Health and Welfare, and is considering submission of a Bill to hold population increase in check, in an attempt to easily deal with Opposition accusations regarding the population problem. However, just when he is in the Diet giving a major policy speech to the Welfare Ministry Committee about decreasing the population, Ranko, his 48-year-old wife, heads to a maternity clinic and discovers that she is pregnant. To make matters worse, he finds out that his eldest son, Jotaro, had been secretly having an affair with his own secretary, Saeko Godai, and it seems that she is also expecting a little 'Burden of Love.' Also, the Araki family's young daughter, Sakura, has become pregnant with her fiancé before their upcoming marriage, and even the retired patron of the family, Jozo, 2 presents yet another possibility of a pregnancy with his much younger mistress. Furthermore, Jozaburo visits Kyoto on an election campaign and is astounded to learn of the existence of his own love-child with his former lover, Some Kaida! As if that's not enough trouble, the Araki family finds that even their maid, Oteru, and their business manager, Yamaguchi, have somehow also ended up with their own 'Burden of Love.' And that is how the population explosion in the household of the Minister of Health and Welfare somehow becomes a factor in the future of Japan...

title: The Gene of AI

title: Enakkule
description: Two childhood friends, a boy and girl who spends time together in primary school. One day that boy's parents lost their lives in a horrific road accident in front of that girl. Thereafter, the girl become his whole world and he is ready to do anything for her. Meanwhile, the girl's mother is suspicious about their relationship and therefore they forced the girl to get marry. After the marriage, the boy feels lonely. At the same time the girl also facing a very hard time that putting her life at risk. The boy takes a weird decision that saves her life and solve many puzzles, but..

title: Ye Ladki Bhi Na...
description: The journey of a young girl through various relationships in her life.

title: A Week to Time Travel
description: In the near future, Ankit a common man living in the city is shortlisted for a Time Travel program by the Intellectual Society. He has one week left in hand to take part in the program. In the course of that time he meets some people and certain incidents in his life influence him to think about whether he should really be part of this program or not.

title: Sandik
description: The fate of Turan Village, which a charming village located in an area of great natural beauty surrounded by mountains, canyons and rivers far away from the city, will change with the departure of unknown helicopters.
